name: item fits at slot
reason: Tests whether an item fits a grid slot: refuses worn and quick slots, a column plus width above 10, a row plus height above 12 (critter) or 96 (container) and any occupied cell, but accepts at once when the item merges into an existing stack; our rule has the rectangle bounds and the session checks occupancy and merges. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Simulation.Items.InventoryGridRules.Fits, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: room for item in grid
reason: Builds a holder's occupancy grid (0x466260) and finds the first free place for the item's size (0x4675A0), returning the slot or -1; ours does it for the hero's grid only (FindSlot and Occupied compose in the session), the loot window uses its own arrange.

name: item insert check
reason: the hero only: the weight (WE4, ARC-WORLD-085) for an item entering the hero's list from outside and the background part (BG4: a Technophobia PC refuses an item of negative complexity, code 15) where the session knows the item's complexity; the moves inside the hero's inventory test the whole load and the room of the session's grid (IW12, ARC-UI-019); a key going onto the hero's key ring skips the weight and the room (KY3, ARC-WORLD-123); the room of any other item entering from outside and an NPC's weight are the host's insert check

name: item insert
reason: the merge of an ammunition item into a held stack of the same prototype (its units added, the item deleted; a sum that does not fit 32 bits refused) and the new stack otherwise; the insert-item event runs through the host's SCR dispatcher (ARC-SCRIPT-013, ARC-SCRIPT-041); slots, the wield of a worn slot, gold and a key ring item are not modelled; a key item is folded into the hero's key list (0x466A00)

name: key fold
reason: a key item taken by the hero (pickup, loot, a dialog's item) is destroyed and its number appended to the hero's list, which stands for the one ring the hero always holds; no ring item, no key that stays loose, no ring art update, no other holder

name: key ring add
reason: the PC's key numbers only, kept as a list in the story section; no key-ring item and no ring art update; the key item the caller names is destroyed through the item path (ARC-WORLD-123)

name: key ring merge
reason: When a key ring item enters a holder it moves the keys between the rings: the holder's loose keys go into the inserted ring, or the inserted ring's key numbers go into the holder's ring, then both ring arts are refreshed (0x466BD0); we keep one key list on the hero and have no ring item.

name: key ring art refresh
reason: Sets a key ring's inventory art to the empty or the filled variant according to whether its key list is empty, then sends the change to the other players through the item field setter; we have no key ring item and no ring art update.

name: insert lock granted callback
reason: Multiplayer lock callback run when an item insert is granted: raises the network counter, inserts the item (0x466640), sets item flag 0x400000, lowers the counter and sends a notification packet (kind 24); single player never needs the lock. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: insert lock denied callback
reason: Multiplayer lock callback run when an item insert is denied: writes a log line with the item's name, clears item flag 0x400000 and frees the pending request record. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: inventory changed refresh
reason: After a holder's item list changes it refreshes the critter's animation speed (0x436FA0) and, for a player critter, calls two interface refresh callbacks (globals 0x5E86CC and 0x5E8660); ours revises hotkeys, grid and encumbrance level per change and leaves animation speed and redraw to the host. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Session.GameSessionOwner.Revise, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: item removal from holder
reason: Asks the item's holder (0x4612A0), logs an error and returns when there is none, else calls the inventory removal 0x467860; ours covers the hero's drop, throw and take paths and NPC paths in the AI host, not one shared entry. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: drop placement
reason: the session's drops only (the hero's critical drops, an NPC's critical drops, a broken container's spill); no network message; junk piles of the map data take nothing; the scripts of the sweep and the insert are not run: an item with a get or insert-item script stays loose; an ammunition or gold item does not merge into a stack in the pile; beyond the project's bounds nothing is piled

name: inventory arrange
reason: the multiplayer client branch (a request to the server, 0x4EDE80) is not built; the hero's list order is the session's (kit, taken, made, then the gold pile)

name: item refusal text lookup
reason: accessor: Turns an insert refusal code into a text by fetching message number 100 plus the code from the item message file (0 for no code); the viewer writes its own refusal wording instead of fetching the original text.

name: item refusal message shown
reason: When the refusing holder is a player it looks up the refusal text (0x4673B0) and posts it to the local player's message window; ours shows the viewer's own wording for the refusal in the window and the status line. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.World.AreaInventoryHost.Refusal, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: gold amount transfer request
reason: Gold quantity request from the inventory window: a multiplayer client packs three object ids and the count into packet 125, otherwise it sets item flag 1 on the pile, moves the coins through 0x464830 and calls 0x4EE3A0; ours moves gold through its own session methods and has no separate request step.

name: gold transfer single player branch
reason: Original: tail of the gold amount transfer request 0x467440 for a single player game: sets item flag 1 on the pile, moves the requested coins through 0x464830 and runs the target action 0x4EE3A0 on the pile. Ours: moves gold through its own session methods and has no step that sets the pile flag or runs that target action (same state as the row of 0x467440).

name: kill quick slot item return
reason: Multiplayer games only: for every item of a dying critter whose inventory location is a quick slot (2000..2009) lays the item on the critter's tile and takes it back to the critter, called from the kill experience award. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: wield on hook
reason: Wield-on hook of the insert: for weapon or shield slots sets the critter's weapon art and refreshes the interface, for the body armour slot sets the armour art, then runs the item's spells (0x4CB7D0), recalculates the light and fires the wield-on script; ours runs the spells after the move and the art is the viewer's. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: inventory removal
reason: Takes an item out of its holder's list: ends its running spells, nulls the holder's stack field of that kind, unwields a worn item, flags an NPC giver for re-wielding, fires the remove-item script, dissolves an emptied junk pile, recalculates encumbrance and refreshes speed; the hero and AI paths implement parts, no single entry. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: wield off hook
reason: Wield-off hook of the removal: for weapon or shield slots restores the weapon art, for body armour sets the bare art, then runs the item's unwear spells (0x4CBFC0), recalculates the light and fires the wield-off script; ours runs the spells after the move and the art is the viewer's. Read once (F1) and not compared branch by branch.

name: remove lock granted callback
reason: Multiplayer lock callback run when an item removal is granted: raises the network counter, removes the item (0x467860), clears item flag 0x400000, lowers the counter and sends a notification packet (kind 25). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remove lock denied callback
reason: Multiplayer lock callback run when an item removal is denied: writes a log line with the item's name, sets item flag 0x400000 and frees the pending request record. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: take removal failure flag
reason: Returns a global flag that the inventory removal sets when it fails and clears it; it is read by two container content generators (0x463730 and 0x463860) after a removal; ours has no such flag.

name: schedule item decay
reason: the session's ground items only (ARC-WORLD-063: and the items in its junk piles); the editor's switch is never set; beyond the project's bound of pending events a drop gets none; the no-decay flag is read from an attached seed only

name: item decay cancel
reason: When the item no longer decays (0x468010) removes its pending Item Decay events with a predicate on the item and returns 1, else 0; ours cancels unconditionally on a pickup or deletion and tests decay in the schedule.

name: item decay event predicate
reason: other: Predicate used with the event removal of 0x468110: true when the event's object parameter equals the item stored in two globals; our event removal takes the entity code in a lambda.

name: loot counter raise
reason: Increments the loot window counter (global 0x5E8800) when the inventory window closes on a container; ours has the host report whether a container is shown instead of keeping a counter. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Session.ISessionLootWindowWorld.LootWindowShowsContainer, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: loot counter lower
reason: Decrements the loot window counter (global 0x5E8800) when the inventory window opens on a container in loot mode; ours has the host report whether a container is shown instead of keeping a counter. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Session.ISessionLootWindowWorld.LootWindowShowsContainer, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: loot counter read
reason: Returns the loot window counter (global 0x5E8800), read by item decay events and the NPC pickup starter; ours has a host flag for decay and an NpcPickupsOn switch for the AI. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Session.ISessionLootWindowWorld.LootWindowShowsContainer, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: prototype module init
reason: interpreted: Once at start: allocates a table of the 20 groups' first prototype ids, runs the check that builds missing prototype files (0x468660), restarts the object system when any was built, then reads every prototype file; our builder runs the check in the interpreter and the data loader reads the files.

name: prototype module shutdown
reason: start-up: Module exit: frees every prototype object of the 20 groups (0x468800), releases the group id table and clears the loaded flag; the viewer keeps prototypes as read-only records.

name: prototype file write
reason: interpreted: Writes one prototype object to its file named from the id number and the object's name; refuses an object whose id is not a prototype id; our builder runs it in the interpreter over a host file layer.

name: group first prototype object
reason: accessor: Copies the stored 24-byte id of a group's first prototype from the table built at init and resolves it to the object through 0x4E50E0; our typed prototype records replace the lookup.

name: prototype object from number
reason: accessor: Turns a basic prototype number into its prototype id (the number plus 20) and resolves it to the prototype object; our code adds the 20 where it needs a prototype file number.

name: prototype group of number
reason: accessor: Returns the object type of a basic prototype number: counts the group starts of groups 1 to 18 at or below it and reads 18 as 16; the interpreter runs it inside the build.

name: prototype group start number
reason: accessor: Returns the first basic prototype number of the group with the given index from the table of 20 starts.

name: prototype file check
reason: interpreted: For each of the 20 groups and each basic number composes the prototype file name and, when the file does not exist, builds it (0x468890) and sets the caller's built flag; run by our builder in the interpreter.

name: prototype name number of group
reason: interpreted: Returns the object name message number for a group index (400 for walls, 800 for portals and so on, 0 outside the 20 groups) that the build puts into the prototype's name field; run in the interpreter.

name: prototype objects free all
reason: start-up: Frees every prototype object of the 20 groups by resolving each number's prototype id to its object and destroying it; used only by the module shutdown.

name: prototype id from number
reason: accessor: Builds the 24-byte prototype id of a basic number by adding 20 and copies it to the caller's buffer; our code adds the 20 at its use.

name: prototype build from number
reason: interpreted: Builds one prototype: creates an object of the number's type, sets its name field and prototype id, fills the group's defaults (0x468930), writes the file (0x468330) and frees the object; run by our builder in the interpreter.

name: prototype group fill
reason: interpreted: The one switch that fills every built-in prototype with its field values (about 85,000 instructions of field-setter calls); Arcanum.Executable runs it as the original code and writes no global, so nothing is reimplemented.

name: critter file loader forwarder
reason: thunk: Forwards its three arguments (object handle and prototype number) to the critter text-file loader 0x49B340; called from the prototype group fill. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: unique critter group fill
reason: interpreted: Tail of the prototype group fill for the 12 unique-critter numbers from 27309: loads a base critter record through 0x49AFF0, then writes script and other fields in code. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter file loader forwarder
reason: thunk: Second copy of the forwarder to the critter text-file loader 0x49B340 (object handle and prototype number). Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: raise field by percent
reason: interpreted: Reads one numeric field of an object and adds the given percent of it back (value times percent over 100); a helper of the prototype group fill. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: prototype description number
reason: accessor: Takes an object, reads its prototype link and returns the prototype number less 20 (the description number that tests such as junk pile 3023 compare); our typed records use prototype numbers directly.

name: item worth from complexity
reason: interpreted: If an item's magic or tech complexity is non-zero adds three tenths of its square to the item's worth; a helper of the prototype group fill. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter text file loader
reason: interpreted: For a critter prototype number in the npc (17067-17316), unique (27309-27393) or monster (28310-28471) range finds its record in the matching rules text file and fills the object: IDs, hit points, art, stats, spells. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter text line parser
reason: interpreted: Reads the next record of a critter rules text file, parsing its Key: value lines (flags, basic stats, spells, script, damage, hit points) and returns the prototype number or -1 at the end. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: hit point target setter
reason: interpreted: Sets an object's maximum hit points to a target by changing its hit point adjustment by the difference; used by the critter text parser for the Hit Points key. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter text key handler
reason: interpreted: Converts the value text of critter lines into field writes (flag names through 0x49BF10, stat and spell numbers, damage pair, script counters, hit points); called by the line parser 0x49B5A0. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: flag name lookup
reason: interpreted: Finds a name by case-insensitive prefix in a table of flag names and returns its flag bit, or reports an unknown flag and returns 0; the census range also holds a developer export of all critters to text. Run unchanged by the interpreter of the player's executable in PrototypeBuilder (Arcanum.Executable), not reimplemented.

name: critter record text writer
reason: debug: Writes one critter prototype as a text record (stats, flags, spells, damage, script, hit points) in the critter rules file format; used only by the developer export of the critters to text files.

name: flag names writer
reason: debug: Writes a line with the table name of every bit set in a flag mask; helper of the developer critter text export.

name: multiplayer module init
reason: Module init: checks or creates the Players folder, sets the default player name and 8 player maximum, clears the 8 slots and the character caches and loads the multiplayer message file; returns 1. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module exit
reason: Module exit: stops the network if running, frees a pending list and the per-slot character blobs, destroys the pending-request table, unloads the message file and the matchmaker layer. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module reset
reason: Module reset (skipped while a reset-suppress counter is set): stops the network, recreates the pending table, restores the default module and player names and 8 players, clears the slots and tables and removes the multiplayer timer event. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module save
reason: Writes the multiplayer module's part of a save: markers, the ids of stored characters of players who left and the slot table. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer module load
reason: Reads the multiplayer module's part of a save back: markers, stored character ids and the slot table. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: module data load stub
reason: other: Module data-load slot of the multiplayer module: does nothing and returns 1.

name: multiplayer module unload
reason: Module unload: raises the remote-change counter, destroys the loaded character objects through 0x4A3D00 and lowers the counter again. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear player slot
reason: Clears one 80-byte player-table slot: zeroes its record, marks no party (-1) and sets default flags. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network start
reason: Starts the network layer (0x5271D0), registers the packet dispatcher 0x49D690, the validator 0x4A2020 and the event handler 0x4A2070 and clears the remote-change counter; returns 1 on success. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network stop
reason: Unregisters the dispatcher and stops the network layer, clearing the network-active word and the counter; returns 1 when the layer reports stopped. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: become host forwarder
reason: thunk: Jumps to the network host start 0x527E80; the census range also holds an unreferenced next function that stores a callback in a global read by 0x4A2A30.

name: start module instance
reason: Host start of a game: checks the module's .dat, makes a new world instance with a fresh GUID, loads the module and the temporary save and sets game running (tail 0x49CEE0). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: create player character
reason: Creates and starts a joining slot's player character: object creation, the reset 0x4A6010, the auto-equip 0x4A5670, placement and notification of the others. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: multiplayer timer event
reason: Time event of the multiplayer game: periodic broadcasts to clients, sends of the time and removal of players who left, offering a leaving player to save their character. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: timer event match test
reason: Predicate over a time-event entry that is true for an integer-parameter entry whose value equals a global; passed as a filter by the multiplayer timer event. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: open multiplayer map
reason: Opens a map by name for a multiplayer game: validates the object system before and after the load and loads the map files from the current save folder. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network packet dispatcher
reason: One switch on the packet type 1..130 (six types empty) that applies a received packet: client requests on the host only, host replication on clients only; reached only as a registered callback. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: apply animation goal
reason: Applies a received animation goal to an object: when the object handle is set forwards the six values to 0x43E770; called by the dispatcher for the animation packets. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot to object
reason: Slot number 0..7 to the player object: looks up the slot's stored ID in the object registry and stores the handle; returns 1 when found, else a null handle and 0. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: broadcast player list
reason: When the network is a host builds the list of the admitted slots' object IDs and sends it to all clients (packet type 2). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: packet type validator
reason: Validator registered with the network layer: accepts packet types 1..130; type 0 and anything outside the range is refused. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: notice broadcast
reason: Sends a notice packet (type 67) with one value to all clients. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network event handler
reason: Handler for network events 0..13: 5 a join request (admission, level and password checks), 8 a client left, 11 the game started; runs the notification hook 0x4A2A30. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network notice hook
reason: callback slot: Calls the function in the global stored by the unreferenced setter after 0x49CC50 when set, else tail-calls 0x4606E0 (a second hook slot); called by the network event handler.

name: player lagging notice
reason: For a given object: marks it lagging locally (0x433170) and on the host broadcasts packet 0x44. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: player recovered notice
reason: For a given object: marks it recovered locally (0x433220) and on the host broadcasts packet 0x45. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear slot by number
reason: Clears the player-table slot of a given number through 0x49CB80. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network flag setter
reason: accessor: Stores its argument in a global read in the packet dispatcher region; called by two interface functions.

name: object to slot
reason: Object to slot number: for each of the 8 slots checks it is active and its player object equals the given handle; returns 0..7 or -1. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot to player object
reason: Returns the player object handle of an active slot, or null. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: network apply test
reason: Network test: answers 1 in single player and in a network game only while the dispatcher applies a received packet; callers apply locally on 1, else broadcast. Single player always takes the local branch. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remote change count up
reason: Raises the counter that marks a received change being applied. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remote change count down
reason: Lowers the remote-change counter, not below zero. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: first player object
reason: Starts a walk over the players: in single player returns the hero (0x40DA50); in a network game the first active slot's player object (null when none). The single-player branch is the hero lookup our session provides. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: next player object
reason: Continues the player walk of 0x4A2BE0 with the next active slot's object, null at the end; callers include the AI near and tick-distance tests. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: queue animation record
reason: Allocates a 0x1B0-byte record, copies a received animation record into it and pushes it on a pending list; called by the dispatcher. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: animation goal sync
reason: Network handling of an animation goal: on the host (network bit 2) sends the goal data to the clients, on a client applies it through 0x4A1F30; read at call level only. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: free lock list
reason: Frees every record of the object-lock list; called by the module init. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: host lock check
reason: Host side of an item lock request: checks the object's lock flag and calls the granted or denied callback (0x4A3080/0x4A3030 keep the lock records). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: add lock record
reason: Pushes a new lock record (object ID, second ID, holder value, count 1) onto the lock list. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: find lock record
reason: Finds the lock record of an object ID in the lock list, null when none. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: release object lock
reason: Lowers the lock count of an object that carries the lock flag; at zero clears the flag and removes the record. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: remove lock record
reason: Removes the lock record of an object ID from the lock list and frees it. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: item lock request
reason: Lock request that item insert, remove and placement call: single player runs the granted callback at once; the host checks the lock; a client stores the callback under a sequence number marks the item busy and sends packet 80. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: send map files
reason: Host side of a join: sends the current map's files and a transfer file with the animation, magic-tech and trap module states to the client, with post-handlers 0x4A54A0 and 0x4A54E0. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: send players folder
reason: Sends the Players folder (character files) to a joining client through a temporary folder. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: send other characters
reason: Sends the other players' character files and portraits to a joining client. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: empty function
reason: other: Does nothing and returns at once.

name: clock global getter
reason: accessor: Returns a global word; its only caller is the clock step 0x45B370.

name: save player character
reason: Host: writes the local player's character file (0x4A39F0) and calls the given completion callback; client: asks the host with packet 46 and schedules a timeout event. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: save callback setter
reason: accessor: Stores a completion callback and its argument in two globals; called by the save of 0x4A38B0.

name: write character file
reason: Writes a PC to Players\G_<GUID>.mpc: serialises the object with its auto-level scheme after the inventory is dropped, plus two portrait bitmaps. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: destroy character list
reason: Destroys every object of the loaded character-file list and frees the list. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: list character files
reason: Lists the Players\G_*.mpc files, loads each with 0x4A3F40 into the list and counts them. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: import character file
reason: Reads a character file into a new object; refuses a PC that carries an inventory or followers. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot character present
reason: accessor: Tells whether a slot has a received character blob.

name: store slot character
reason: Stores a received character blob (ID, size and bytes) in a slot, freeing the old one. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot character data
reason: accessor: Returns a pointer to the bytes of a slot's character blob, or null.

name: slot character size
reason: accessor: Returns the byte size of a slot's character blob, or 0.

name: slot character id
reason: accessor: Copies the object ID stored with a slot's character blob, or a null ID.

name: slot character record
reason: accessor: Returns the raw record pointer of a slot's character blob.

name: slot character record size
reason: accessor: Returns the size of the slot's character record: the blob size field of the slot plus 0x28 (the header); the player-export caller passes it as the length of a copy.

name: reset suppress count up
reason: accessor: Raises a counter that makes the multiplayer module reset do nothing; called by two windows.

name: reset suppress count down
reason: Lowers the reset-suppress counter; the census range also holds the separate next function 0x4A4290 (no callers) that builds a character file path from an object and stores one file-layer result, role not settled. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: save local hero character
reason: Builds Players\<id>.mpc for the local hero, applies one field change (0x424070) and writes the character with 0x4A39F0; returns success. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: cache character info
reason: Adds or updates a character-file info entry (ID, name and description text) in a ring of 8 entries. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: find cached character
reason: Finds an object ID among the 8 cached character-file info entries and copies out its strings; returns -1 when absent. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: write scheme to file
reason: Writes character-file data (the auto-level scheme included) of a PC into its Players file and refreshes the info cache; called by the character windows and the auto-level run. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: read character header
reason: Reads a character file's header strings from the Players folder or the temporary copy into the info cache. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: read character extra
reason: Reads a character file's header and extra data strings into the info cache; same shape as 0x4A47D0 with one more read. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: character portrait path
reason: Builds the portrait bitmap path Players\<id><suffix>.bmp of a multiplayer PC (used by the portrait draw, PO3). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: matchmaker config read
reason: Reads Rules\Matchmaker.mes and copies several entries into globals of the matchmaker layer. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: matchmaker forwarder 4f5820

name: item pick flag set
reason: Single player: sets the no-display item flag (0x10) on the picked item and returns 1; a network player also reserves the pick in a per-slot table and broadcasts packet 93. Steamwoven writes no such flag.

name: item pick flag clear
reason: Clears the pick flag set by 0x4A50D0 on an item when the item is put down or moved in the same holder; for the local player in a network game also releases the slot reservation and sends a packet.

name: clear pick table
reason: Zeroes the table of 8 per-slot reserved item handles; called by module init and reset. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: reserve slot item
reason: Reserves an item for a slot if the slot holds none yet and sets the item's no-display flag; returns 1 on success. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: release slot item
reason: Clears the reservation of an item for a slot and the item's no-display flag. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear open window table
reason: Zeroes the table of 8 per-slot container handles; called by module init and reset. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: set open container
reason: Stores the container a slot has open in the per-slot table and, for a local change in a network game, broadcasts packet 97; the inventory window close also reaches it. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: container open check
reason: Tells whether an object handle is in the per-slot open-container table; called by the junk pile dissolve in a network game.

name: matchmaker ping
reason: Module ping slot: when the matchmaker layer is loaded (0x4A4ED0) calls its poll 0x4A4EE0. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: restart animations after transfer
reason: Post-handler of a transferred animation module state: for each live record of the animation table that has not ended restarts it. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: restart spell runs after transfer
reason: Post-handler of the transferred magic-tech state: restarts each active spell run of the 0x158-byte table. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: set slot option bits
reason: Sets bits of mask 0xFF00 in a slot's flag word and broadcasts the result (packet 98). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: clear slot option bits
reason: Clears bits of mask 0xFF00 in a slot's flag word and broadcasts the result (packet 98). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: slot option bits
reason: accessor: Returns a slot's flag word masked with 0xFF00 (the player option bits).

name: stored character limit
reason: accessor: Returns the maximum of stored characters of players who left (default 10).

name: set stored character limit
reason: accessor: Stores the maximum of stored characters of players who left.

name: apply player settings
reason: Applies a player's stored options always run, auto attack, auto switch and follower skills through 0x430580, 0x4B8280, 0x4B8380 and 0x4C8FF0; called only from multiplayer code. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip joining character
reason: Entry of the multiplayer auto-equip: loads Rules\AutoEquip.mes and, when the server option allows it, gives the joining PC gold and items by background, skills and scheme, then wields the best. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip gold
reason: Creates starting gold from an AutoEquip entry scaled by the PC's background money and inserts it into the PC's inventory. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip background items
reason: Gets the background's item list and gives those items to the PC through 0x4A5E10. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip skill stage
reason: Auto-equip stage that picks AutoEquip entries from a stat and skill counts of the PC and gives them through 0x4A5920. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip entry give
reason: Looks up an AutoEquip entry and its follow-up entry and gives or wields the items through 0x4A5D80 and 0x4A5E10. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip stat stage
reason: Auto-equip stage that chooses entries from skill counts with cut-offs 75 and 20 and gives them through 0x4A5920. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip race stage
reason: Auto-equip stage that maps the PC's race class and two stats to an entry number and gives it through 0x4A5920. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip wield list
reason: Parses a list of prototype numbers from entry text and tries to wield each (0x462540), counting the successes. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip item list
reason: Parses a list of prototype numbers from entry text, creates each item with the creation wrapper 0x4ED8B0 and inserts it into the PC (0x4617F0). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: auto equip schematic items
reason: Auto-equip stage that gives the product of the highest learned technology schematic per discipline (schematic number 1990 + 200 per discipline + 10 per degree). Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: player character export reset
reason: Resets a player character for a multiplayer export or join: hit point and fatigue damage, combat state, quests, rumors, blessings and curses, reputations, followers, flags, variables and spell flags are cleared; multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET).

name: multiplayer damage veto
reason: Answers whether damage from one critter to another is vetoed by the multiplayer player-killing and friendly-fire options, looking at the critter types, their leaders and a network option word; multiplayer is deferred. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: character export to file
reason: Exports a player character to a file after export and overwrite prompts: saves a temporary game, resets the character, writes the file and reloads the temporary save; multiplayer is deferred. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: character file name check
reason: Splits a character file path and tests the name part for a fixed trailing pattern when it is long, optionally rebuilding the path without it; part of the multiplayer character files, which are deferred. Multiplayer is deferred (FR-NET-001..008).

name: experience table load
reason: project admission: an entry that is not a number is refused instead of read with atoi

name: level scheme tables release
reason: start-up: At exit frees the message files and tables the level-up rules loaded (user and game level scheme files, name and cost tables); nothing to port.

name: level recalculation
reason: a PC without effects on its level; the scheme runs through the caller's per-level step (ARC-WORLD-036); each level written is reported for its level-up message, which the viewer posts (ARC-UI-046)

name: follower level update
reason: the follower's level and points; the session runs its scheme (GameSessionOwner.LevelFollower)

name: critter auto-level scheme read
reason: accessor: Returns the auto-level scheme number stored in a player character or NPC (minus one for any other object); our sheets carry the scheme as a plain field.

name: auto-level scheme setter
reason: the hero's scheme and the NPC advancement records; a number outside 0..199 is refused, where the original stores any number and buys nothing with it (a documented deviation: the snapshot bounds schemes to 0..199)

name: level scheme name check
reason: Returns the scheme number when the scheme's level-name text exists (numbers 1 to 49 in the user file and 50 to 199 in the game file) and 0 otherwise; it reads the name files, not the rule files, which 0x4A6E40 reads (Arcanum.Data.Characters.AutoLevelTables.Rule).

name: level set
reason: only the scheme run of a new PC; the reset to the default sheet, the experience and the points of a level above 1 are the starting hero's (a new PC is level 1)

name: auto-level scheme run
reason: the purchase text is built by the viewer from the run's purchases (ARC-UI-046, AreaLevelMessages); no multiplayer scheme

name: scheme rule run
reason: the rule is parsed once by Parse, which refuses a missing target, a target of more than 9 digits, a college target above 5 or a discipline target above 7 and text outside printable ASCII

name: level-up purchase log
reason: Logs one purchase of the level-up text by name: a repeated name only updates its value and at most ten names are kept; the text is built from the log afterwards. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.World.AreaLevelMessages.SchemeText, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: light hour table allocate
reason: start-up: Allocates the table of 24 hourly colour entries used by the ambient light scheme and answers 1.

name: light scheme default apply
reason: start-up: Applies the default light scheme at hour 12 through the scheme setter; only referenced as a start-up hook, no direct caller.

name: light scheme catalogue load
reason: Opens the lighting schemes catalogue at module load and applies the default scheme at hour 12; ours reads the catalogue and every scheme file in one strict read. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Data.Lighting.AreaLightingReader.Read, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: light scheme catalogue release
reason: start-up: Frees the opened lighting schemes catalogue and marks the current scheme as none at module unload.

name: light hour table release
reason: start-up: Frees the table of hourly colour entries at exit.

name: light scheme save
reason: Writes the current light scheme number and the hour it was set for to the save; our ambient light is recomputed from the clock and the active sector and is not saved.

name: light scheme load
reason: Reads the saved light scheme number and hour and applies them through the scheme setter; our ambient light is recomputed after a load instead.

name: default light scheme set
reason: accessor: Stores the map default light scheme number when it is above 0 and answers 1 (else 0); our map default is part of the lighting source record.

name: default light scheme get
reason: accessor: Returns the stored map default light scheme number.

name: light scheme set
reason: Sets the active light scheme (0 means the map default): loads the scheme file by the catalogue name and parses it when the scheme changes, then applies the hour; ours resolves the scheme per sector from the preloaded source. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Data.Lighting.AmbientLightingState.Apply, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: current light scheme get
reason: accessor: Returns the number of the active light scheme.

name: light hour apply
reason: Takes an hour 0 to 23, remembers it and sets the ambient outdoor and indoor colours from that hour of the active scheme while a busy flag is raised; ours selects the pair and the viewer applies it. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Data.Lighting.AmbientLightingState.Apply, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

name: light hour get
reason: accessor: Returns the hour for which the light scheme was last applied.

name: light hour busy flag read
reason: accessor: Returns the flag raised while the light hour is being applied, which makes the per-object run kill skip (goal table GT13); our hour apply is not re-entered so there is nothing to gate.

name: light scheme parse
reason: Parses a scheme file of 24 hourly lines of outdoor and indoor colours and fills the gaps between given hours in integer steps without wrapping; ours is strict about the keys and ranges. The nearest method of ours is Arcanum.Data.Lighting.LightSchemeParser.TryParse, which carries no OriginalFunction mark: the behaviour is not reproduced as one method of this function.

reason: Writes the frame field of an art id (field position depends on the class); a frame at or past the frame count of the art's animation (read through 0x5030B0) wraps to 0 and a negative frame goes to the last frame. Ours has EyeCandyArt.WithFrame for eye candy only and no art header lookup.

name: set art variant nibble
reason: For tile, wall, portal and roof arts (classes 0, 1, 3, 10) replaces the low four bits of the art id by the given value and logs Range exceeded in art set when it is 16 or more; other classes are returned unchanged. No method of ours.

name: art palette frames loaded test
reason: renderer: Looks the art up in the cache and answers 0 when the cached art holds frame data for the id's palette, 0x10 when not (error 0xD when the art is not cached).

name: read art frame pixel
reason: renderer: Reads one pixel colour of a frame of a cached art at a given x and y for the art's palette, flipping the rows of a critter's mirrored rotation; used by the light drawing and sampling code and by 0x5380F0.

name: art frame pixel opaque test
reason: Tests one pixel of a cached art frame: answers 0x10 when the palette index there is 0 or 1 (transparent) and 0 for an opaque pixel, mirroring the rows for a critter's mirrored rotation; used by the roof hit test 0x439890 and the screen object pick 0x43D9F0. Ours takes this test from the viewer (AreaHoverIndex.Pick opaqueAt callback), no method of ours carries the address.

name: art header facts
reason: Fills a record with the frame count, frames per second, action frame and frame data pointers of the cached art for the id's palette and rotation (0x10 when the art is not cached); goals read it for animation pace and the frame set wrapping. Ours has the result types (EyeCandyClip, EyeCandyFacts) fed by the host from the decoded ART header (ArtDecoder), no method carries the address.

name: frame data of art
reason: only the roof branch: a mirrored roof frame takes hot spot x 0 and offset x 0

name: copy art frame pixels
reason: editor: Copies the pixel rows of a cached art frame (rotation and frame from the id) into a caller buffer; its only caller is the bitmap export writer 0x5360F0 (a second entry 0x5033E0 sums frame offsets), not reachable from the game.

name: art frame bounding extent
reason: renderer: Computes the largest frame width and height over all frames of the cached art for the id's rotation set (4 rotations for critters when rotation mirroring is on, otherwise 8); used by the cursor code 0x4FFD60 and 0x4FFFE0 to size the cursor surface.

name: tile art id builder
reason: Builds a tile art id (class 0) from eight parts (tile number below 64, second tile number below 64, rotation and flag parts with their limits) and returns error 0xC when one is out of range; callers are the tile name loader and the terrain fill. No method of ours; tile art ids are read from map data and the terrain code uses the raw ids.

name: tile art position
reason: Returns the tile position field of an art id: bits 22 to 27 for a tile (class 0), bits 11 to 16 for a facade (class 11), 0 for any other class; it picks the tile name record. Our private TileSoundTable.Locate reads the same bits inline for the tile sound and name tables; no method carries this address. Read once (F1).

name: tile art second number
reason: Returns bits 16 to 21 of a tile art id (the neighbouring tile number of a transition tile), 0 for other classes; callers are the tile helper 0x4D71E0 and tile name loader 0x4EAE90. No method of ours.

name: tile art edge number
reason: Returns the edge or corner part (bits 12 to 15) of a tile art id, mapped through the swap table 0x5BE8C0 when the art is flipped (0x504FD0); 0 for other classes; used by the tile name loader and the tile art setters. No method of ours.

name: set tile art edge number
reason: Sets the edge part (bits 12 to 15) of a tile art id for tile (class 0) arts and logs Range exceeded in art set for a value of 16 or more; swaps the part through the table 0x5BE880 and flips the art when the table says so. Called by the tile art builder 0x503600 only. No method of ours.

name: tile art rotation number
reason: Returns the rotation part (bits 9 to 11) of a tile art id, plus 8 when the swap tables 0x5BE8C0 and 0x5BE880 agree and the art is flipped; 0 for non tile arts. Callers are the tile helper 0x4D71E0 and tile name loader 0x4EAE90. No method of ours.

name: set tile art rotation number
reason: Sets the rotation part (bits 9 to 11, 0 to 7 plus a flip adjustment for 8 to 15) of a tile art id, applying the swap tables and the flip flag; logs Range exceeded in art set at 16 or more. Called by the tile art builder 0x503600 and the tile helper 0x4D71E0. No method of ours.

name: tile art flipped test
reason: Answers whether an art id is flipped in the sense of the tile mirror: for facades (class 11) bit 26; for tiles (class 0) both flip flags 0x503950 and 0x503990 set; 0 otherwise. Our TileSoundTable.Locate uses the facade bit and the tile flip bit inline for the sound table; no method carries this address. Read once (F1).

name: tile art flippable flag
reason: Returns the flippable flag of an art id: bit 7 for a tile (class 0), the facade rule 0x503900 (bit 26) for facades, 0 otherwise. Our TileSoundTable.Locate reads bit 7 or bit 26 inline; no method carries this address. Read once (F1).

name: tile art second flip flag
reason: Returns bit 6 of a tile art id (a second flip flag), the facade rule 0x503900 for facades, 0 otherwise; callers tile helper 0x4D71E0, tile name loader 0x4EAE90 and 0x503900. Ours reads only bit 7; no method carries bit 6.

name: wall art id builder
reason: Builds a wall art id (class 1) from a wall number below 256, a style below 46, a part below 4, rotation below 8, a variant below 4 and flags (only bits 0x480 allowed), then sets its rotation through 0x502930; returns 0xC when a part is out of range; callers are the object creation and the wall break handler. No method of ours.

name: wall art piece number
reason: Returns the piece field (bits 14 to 19) of a wall art id, 0 for other classes; the wall handlers use it to tell opening pieces (10, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 22, 25, 26, 29 to 32) from solid ones. No method of ours.

name: set wall art piece number
reason: Sets the piece field (bits 14 to 19) of a wall art id (limit 64, logs Range exceeded in art set), unchanged for other classes; called by the wall handlers and the rotation setter 0x502930. No method of ours.

name: wall art number
reason: Returns bits 20 to 27 (the wall number) of a wall art id, 0 for other classes; callers include the wall break handler, portal and wall name lookups. No method of ours.

name: wall art variant
reason: Returns bits 8 and 9 of a wall art id (its damage or style variant, 0 to 3), 0 for other classes; used by the wall handlers. No method of ours.

name: set wall art variant
reason: Sets bits 8 and 9 of a wall art id from 0 to 4 (a value above 4 is logged as Range exceeded in art set and ignored), other classes are returned unchanged; used by the wall handlers and the wall break handler. No method of ours.

name: art flip flags
reason: Returns the flag bits of an art id: 0x480 for walls (class 1), 0x200 for portals (class 3), 0x800 for items (class 6), 0 otherwise; used by the step cost, portal name lookups and the rotation setter. No method of ours.

name: set art flip flags
reason: Replaces the flag bits read by 0x503B70 (0x480 for walls, bit 0x200 for portals, bit 0x800 for items) in an art id; other classes unchanged; used by the rotation setter and the portal and wall name code. No method of ours.

name: critter art id builder
reason: Builds a critter art id (class 2) from nine parts (gender below 2, body below 8, armour part below 16 and further flag, animation, weapon, shield and palette parts with their limits), returning error 0xC for a part out of range; used by the prototype loader, trait changes and object creation. Ours composes critter arts with WeaponArtRules and BodyArmorArtRules setters; no method carries this builder.

name: monster art id builder
reason: Builds a monster art id (class 12) from a species below 32, a body below 8, a flag, an armour part, animation, weapon and palette parts, error 0xC when out of range; used by the critter text file loaders and the prototype loader. No method of ours.

name: unique npc art id builder
reason: Builds a unique npc art id (class 13) from a number below 256 and flag, armour, animation, weapon and palette parts, error 0xC when out of range; used by the unique critter group fill and the critter text line parser. No method of ours.

name: set art animation
reason: Sets the animation field (bits 6 to 10) of a critter, monster or unique npc art id (limit 26, logs Range exceeded in art set), other classes unchanged; used by goals to pick an animation. Ours reads the animation (WeaponArtRules.AnimationOf) but no method sets it with the address.

name: art body of critter art
reason: Returns the body field (bits 24 to 26) of a critter art id (class 2) and 0 for any other class; 1 and 2 are the dwarf and halfling bodies (gait rate +4, autoscale). Ours has HeroBody.GaitRateBonus (a property) for the hero's body only.

name: set art body
reason: Sets the body field (bits 24 to 26) of a critter, monster or unique npc art id (below 8, logs Range exceeded in art set), other classes unchanged; called by the race and gender set 0x441C70. No method of ours.

name: monster species of art
reason: Returns the species field (bits 23 to 27) of a monster art id (class 12), 0 for other classes; the height 0x503F60 reads it in the monster height table. Ours reads it inline in WeaponArtRules.Height; no method carries the address (a second entry 0x503F50 reads table 0x5BE900).

name: gender of critter art
reason: Returns bit 27 of a critter art id (class 2), 0 for other classes; callers include the art name builder 0x41DAE0. No method of ours.

name: set gender of art
reason: Sets bit 27 (gender) of a critter, monster or unique npc art id (0 or 1, logs Range exceeded in art set), other classes unchanged; called by the race and gender set 0x441C70. No method of ours.

name: weapon part of art
reason: Returns the weapon part (bits 0 to 3) of a critter, monster or unique npc art id, 0 for other classes. Nearest ours is WeaponArtRules.Weapon, which does not check the class and carries no address.

name: shield bit of art
reason: Returns bit 19 (the shield flag) of a critter, monster or unique npc art id, 0 for other classes. Nearest ours is WeaponArtRules.Shield, which does not check the class and carries no address.

name: portal art id builder
reason: Builds a portal art id (class 3) from a number below 512, a flag below 2, a part below 32, a rotation below 8 and a variant below 4 (flags only 0x200 allowed), sets its rotation through 0x502930; error 0xC when out of range; used by the portal name loader and object creation. No method of ours.

name: portal art door bit
reason: Returns bit 10 (0x400) of a portal art id (class 3), 0 for other classes; the hover window shows the door icon 436 when it is set, else the generic icon 786. Ours decides the icon in the terrain viewer code (AreaHoverWindow) not in the counted assemblies.

name: scenery art id builder
reason: Builds a scenery art id (class 4) from a number below 512, two parts below 32, a rotation below 8 and a variant below 4, error 0xC when out of range; used by the prototype loaders and the ranged path 0x4B39B0. No method of ours.

name: scenery art kind
reason: Returns bits 6 to 10 of a scenery art id (class 4), 0 for other classes; callers include the art name builder, the tile object finder and the destroy of a combat object. No method of ours.

name: interface art id builder
reason: Builds an interface art id (class 5) from a number below 4096, a frame below 256, a flag bit and a palette below 4; returns 0xC when out of range; used by 146 callers in the HUD, windows and item icons (the vial and panel arts). Ours composes interface arts through the interface mes and art tables inline; no method carries the builder.

name: interface art flag bit
reason: renderer: Returns bit 7 of an interface art id (class 5), 0 for other classes; its only caller is the art draw setup 0x505060.

name: item art id builder
reason: Builds an item art id (class 6) from a number below 1000, a place below 4, two single flag bits (0x800 and 0x400) and four further parts; answers 0 on success or 0xC when out of range or when the number is past the item type's limit (0x502830); used by prototype loaders and the key ring art refresh. No method of ours.

name: item art place
reason: Returns the place field (bits 12 and 13) of an item art id (class 6), 0 for other classes (the wearing place of the item art). No method of ours; the sibling ItemArmor (0x5044F0) is carried by BodyArmorArtRules.

name: set item art place
reason: Sets the place field (bits 12 and 13) of an item art id (below 4, otherwise 0), other classes unchanged; called by the schematic component gate 0x56E190 and 0x5761D0. No method of ours.

name: item art type
reason: Returns the item type (low four bits) of an item art id (class 6), 0 for other classes; 4 and 5 are food and scroll (identification exempt). Ours reads it as AiListItem.IdentificationExempt (a property filled by the host), no method carries the address.

name: item art broken test
reason: Returns the destroyed bit 0x400 of an item art id (class 6), 0 for other classes; used by the object break, sale check, wear check and the item window hit point line. Ours returns a bool with the same class test (the original returns the bit value, callers only test for non-zero). Read once (F1).

name: item art broken set
reason: Sets or clears the destroyed bit 0x400 of an item art id (class 6; other classes come back unchanged); called by the object break 0x43F1C0 and the skill check run 0x4C7160. Ours keeps broken as a flag of ItemCondition (ItemDurabilityRules.Break) and rewrites no art id bit.

name: class 7 art id build
reason: Builds an art id of class 7 (the container class) from a number below 0x200, two 5-bit fields, a 3-bit and a 2-bit field and stores it through the out pointer; any part out of range gives error 12 and no id. Called by the prototype group fill 0x468930 and the art name normalizer 0x41D510; no method of ours builds a class 7 art id.

name: class 7 art field read
reason: accessor: returns bits 6..10 of a class 7 art id, 0 for any other class; the meaning lives in the callers (art name 0x41DAE0 and the normalizer).

name: light art id build
reason: Builds an art id of class 9 (a light) from a number below 0x200, a frame below 0x80, a rotation (below 8, or below 32 when the single-rotation flag is set) and the flag; the rotation is stored twice (a 5-bit and a 3-bit field); a part out of range gives error 12. Called by the carried light colour 0x45FA70, the animation effect line parse 0x4CDDF0 and the shadow map loader 0x4DE5D0; ours has no light art ids (spell lights not ready).

name: light art rotation read
reason: accessor: for a light art id with the single-rotation flag returns the 5-bit rotation field (bits 4..8), otherwise forwards to the general rotation reader 0x502880.

name: light art rotation write
reason: accessor: sets the rotation of a light art id: with the single-rotation flag the value is clamped (32 or more gives 0, below 0 gives 31) and written as both rotation fields, otherwise forwards to the general rotation setter 0x502930.

name: light art single rotation flag
reason: accessor: returns bit 0 of a light art id (class 9), the single-rotation flag, 0 for other classes; the rule lives in its callers (the rotation getter 0x504700, setter 0x504730 and the art cache 0x505060).

name: roof art id build
reason: Builds a roof art id (class 10) from a number below 0x200, a piece below 13 and two flags below 2; pieces 9..12 are stored as pieces 0..3 with the mirror flag set (through the setters 0x502D30 and palette); anything out of range gives error 12. Called by the roof hit test 0x439890 and the roof name loader 0x4ED3E0; ours reads roof art ids from the map and builds none.

name: roof art piece read
reason: Returns the piece of a roof art id: its frame plus 9 when the mirror flag (bit 0 through 0x504FD0) is set, -1 for any other class. Ours AreaRoofGrid.Piece reads the same frame bits and mirror flag; it makes no class test, so a non-roof art does not give -1.

name: roof art piece set
reason: renderer: sets the piece of a roof art id; pieces above 8 become pieces 0..3 with the mirror flag and palette 1 set (through 0x502C40, 0x502D30 and the palette setter 0x502DB0). Used by the art cache 0x505060 and the art name normalizer 0x41D510; the mirroring is drawing detail that ours does by its own roof pieces.

name: roof art filled bit read
reason: accessor: bit 13 of a roof art id, the filled flag of the roof block, 0 for other classes; ours AreaRoofGrid keeps the same bit as its private FillBit and its callers carry the roof rules.

name: roof art filled bit write
reason: accessor: sets or clears bit 13 (filled) of a roof art id; a value above 1 logs 'Range exceeded in art set' and counts as 0. The roof fill rules live in the callers (roof fill flood 0x43A1A0).

name: roof art fade bit read
reason: accessor: bit 12 of a roof art id, the faded flag, 0 for other classes; ours AreaRoofGrid keeps the same bit as its private FadeBit and the rules live in the callers.

name: roof art fade bit write
reason: accessor: sets or clears bit 12 (faded) of a roof art id; a value above 1 logs 'Range exceeded in art set' and counts as 0. The roof fade rules live in the callers (roof fade on 0x439EE0 and off 0x439F20).

name: facade art id build
reason: Builds an art id of class 11 (a facade tile) from a number below 0x200, a field below 0x40, two flags below 2, a value below 0x400 and a last flag below 2; any part out of range gives error 12. Called by the art name normalizer 0x41D510, the facade name loader 0x4EC430 and the walk mask loader 0x4F7020; ours does not host facade art ids.

name: facade art field read
reason: accessor: returns the facade tile number (bits 17..24 plus 0x100 when bit 27 is set, 0 for other classes); a second inner reader at 0x504A90 returns bits 1..10 of a facade art id. The rules live in the callers (facade name loader 0x4EC3F0, 0x4CA2C0).

name: facade art open bit read
reason: accessor: returns bit 0 of a facade art id (class 11), 0 for other classes; the tile blocked test 0x4D7110 treats a facade tile as blocked when this bit is clear (rule PB1 of the world ledger, which lives in that caller).

name: eye candy art variant read
reason: Returns bits 6..7 of an eye candy art id (class 14), the variant, 0 for any other class; used by the art name normalizer and the art name resolver 0x41DAE0. Ours EyeCandyArt.Variant carries the address and reads the same bits but makes no class test.

name: eye candy art translucent bit
reason: Bit 8 (translucent) of an eye candy art id, 0 for other classes; a second setter at 0x504C30 writes the bit. Callers are the object draw 0x43B390 and 0x443170; ours reads the same bit without a class test and has no setter. Read once (F1).

name: eye candy art scale read
reason: Bits 1..3 (scale index) of an eye candy art id; any other class answers 4 (unscaled). Ours reads the same bits without the class default; callers are the object draw and 0x43DFD0. Read once (F1).

name: eye candy art scale write
reason: accessor: writes bits 1..3 (scale index) of an eye candy art id, other classes unchanged; the only caller is the eye candy add 0x4CCF70. The span of this row also holds a never-called art file palette rewrite at 0x504CC0 (opens art file by name, rewrites its palettes), a leftover tool: dead.

name: art low nibble flags read
reason: accessor: returns the low 4 bits of an art id for the classes 0, 1, 3 and 10 (tile, wall, portal, roof), 0 for the others; the roof piece reader 0x504840 and the frame data 0x5031C0 read the mirror bit from it.

name: art colour convert
reason: renderer: converts one palette colour to the display format, through the optional callback in global 0x604744 and 0x533EC0 or else directly with 0x533E90; used when art palettes are built and by the art file loader 0x51B710.

name: art cache surface build
reason: renderer: art cache step that creates the video or system memory surfaces of one art id for every rotation and frame (class 6, 5, 9 and 10 special cases, hardware or software path through 0x5059F0 and the software renderer 0x505EB0), counts the bytes used and frees the rotation on failure; called only by the art blit 0x502360. Read in outline.

name: art blit flag map
reason: renderer: maps the public art blit flag bits (mirror, additive, tinted and others) to the internal blit mask; flags 0x1802C are refused with error 12. Called only by the art blit 0x502360; the font flag meaning is read in ledger WM46.

name: art frame surface lock
reason: renderer: locks the surface of an art frame (video or system memory) and prepares the pixel format and palette handling for the software blit; called only by the art cache surface build 0x505060. Read in outline.

name: software art blit
reason: renderer: the 2D art blitter of the original (85 KB of per-pixel loops: plain, mirrored, additive, tinted, alpha and stipple variants for 16 and 32 bit surfaces; stops with 'Divide by zero in art_blit'); Godot draws instead. Read in outline; the UI ledger reads its blend branches.

name: art cache lookup and load
reason: renderer: finds the art id's file name (0x51AE50), looks it up by name in the sorted art cache and returns the entry index (stamping its last use), else makes room and loads it (0x51B170); when the load fails it logs and loads art/badart.art under the same id and only then fails with -1. Ours has no art cache; the bad art fallback is AreaOriginalArtNames.BadArtPath.

name: art cache video budget set
reason: accessor: stores the argument times a constant (0x596040) into the float global 0x5BEA38, the video memory share of the art cache; called by the module init 0x401000.

name: art cache make room
reason: renderer: when the video (or system) memory budget of the art cache is spent it logs 'Art cache full', sorts the entries by last use (0x51ADE0), frees the oldest entries until enough is free and re-sorts by name (0x51AE00); fails with a message when nothing can be freed.

name: art cache use order compare
reason: renderer: sort callback comparing two art cache entries by their last use stamp (offset 0x108); address taken by the art cache make room 0x51AC20.

name: art cache name order compare
reason: renderer: sort callback comparing two art cache entries by file name (offset 4); address taken by the art cache make room 0x51AC20.

name: font art file names
reason: For an art id of class 8 (font art) it copies the file name of the font chosen by its number (11 hard-coded names, the last art/morph15font.art); for every other class it forwards to the name callback in global 0x604710, set to the art name resolver 0x41DAE0; error 0x10 when no callback. Ours knows the font arts only in the viewer scene (AreaTextFonts); no Arcanum.* method carries it.

name: art cache name search
reason: renderer: binary search of the name-sorted art cache for a file name; returns 1 and the index when found, else 0 and the insert position.

name: art cache entry load
reason: renderer: inserts a new entry into the sorted art cache (growing the table by 32), copies the name, loads the file through 0x51B710 (dropping the entry on failure), sizes the per rotation surface tables (1 for a one-rotation art, 5 for the 3D variants of classes 2, 12 and 13, else 8) and updates the memory counters. A one-rotation art serves every rotation (ledger MA6).

name: art cache entry free
reason: renderer: frees one art cache entry: gives its bytes back to the budgets, frees every rotation's surfaces (0x51B650) and palettes; callers are the art cache make room and the cache purge 0x5021E0.

name: art cache frames rebuild mark
reason: renderer: sets the 'surface needs rebuild' flag of all rotations of one cache entry; called by the lighting refresh loop 0x5022D0.

name: art cache surfaces free
reason: renderer: releases the surfaces of every rotation of a cache entry (13 for a roof, else its frame count) and clears the pointers; called by the cache entry free 0x51B490.

name: art file read
reason: Reads an ART file: a 132-byte header whose word at offset 8 must be 8 (else error 0x10), one group of frames when header bit 0 is set (else 8), up to 4 palette tables of 256 entries converted to the display format, a 28-byte header per frame and the frame data (raw when the stored size equals width times height, else a run length code: high bit literal run, otherwise repeat). Ours ArtDecoder reads the same layout and rules into RGBA; it leaves out the display-format palette conversion, the per-palette choice and the memory accounting for the cache.

name: art group count read
reason: accessor: returns 1 when bit 0 of the art header flags is set, else 8: the number of rotation groups (ledger MA6); ours ArtDecoder keeps it as the private group count in its header parse.

name: art load failure cleanup
reason: renderer: on a failed art file read closes the file, frees the frame buffers (0x51BF20) and the palette tables; called only by 0x51B710.

name: art save cleanup
reason: editor: frees the temporaries of the art file writer (0x5007B0): two buffers, two files and the frame tables; the writer is only reached from the level editor art save chain.

name: art frame buffers free
reason: renderer: frees the per-group frame data and pixel buffers of a loaded art header, group count by header bit 0.

name: art save frame buffers free
reason: editor: frees the frame data and pixel buffers of the art file writer's header (same loop as 0x51BF20); only called by the writer cleanup 0x51BEB0.

name: art frame write
reason: editor: writes one frame of an art file being saved: encodes it (0x51C080) and writes the rows when the result is not smaller than the raw size, else stores the raw size; called only by the art writer 0x5007B0.

name: art frame encode
reason: editor: run length encoder for an art frame: writes literal runs (high bit) and repeat runs of up to 127 bytes and returns the encoded length, -1 on a write failure; the counterpart of the decoder in 0x51B710 for the art file writer.

name: art mask bits write
reason: editor: packs a mask of 2-bit values (four per byte) and writes it row by row; a value of 4 or more fails with error 0x10; used only by the art file writer chain.

name: art frame trim rectangle
reason: editor: finds the bounding rectangle of the used pixels of an art frame (through the corner helper 0x51C6D0) for the art file writer.

name: art frame crop helper
reason: editor: copies a rectangle and shrinks it to the used rows and columns; helper of the art file writer's trim passes 0x51C4E0 and 0x51C890.

name: art frame trim pass
reason: editor: second trim pass of the art file writer: finds the first used column and row with 0x51CA80 and crops with 0x51C6D0.

name: art column empty scan
reason: editor: scans columns of a pixel block for the first column that holds a non-zero pixel; helper of the art file writer trim.

name: window manager init
reason: startup: window manager init through the module table (address taken): clears the window counters and lists, sets all 50 window slots to free and stores the screen rectangle and flags.

name: window manager shutdown
reason: startup: window manager shutdown: destroys every window slot still in use and frees the pending window list.

name: window create
reason: platform: creates one engine window from a description (flags, rectangle, colour key, up to 50 windows; error 1 before init, 3 when full, 12 for a colour-keyed window without a buffer) and allocates its surfaces through 0x5200F0; called for the game window, dialog boxes and menus. Ours builds interface in Godot.

name: close window
reason: platform: TIG window manager: closes a window by handle; frees its surface and its button list through 0x51CDE0, takes it out of the z-order list and marks the slot free in the 0x604778 table. Called by menus and dialogs when they close. Ours uses Godot windows.

name: free window buttons
reason: platform: TIG window manager: frees every button of a window one after another (0x537CE0) until its button count is zero. Called by the window close and by 0x557330.

name: set window message callback
reason: accessor: Stores a callback pointer in a window slot (field +0x35C) when the window has the message-callback flag; returns an error otherwise. Called by interface window builders; the rule lives in the callbacks.

name: get window rectangle
reason: accessor: Copies a window slot's flags, rectangle (x, y, width, height) and three further fields into the caller's buffer. Called by 38 callers; the emulator hook in PrototypeBuilder only supplies the screen rectangle.

name: redraw dirty screen areas
reason: renderer: Screen display step of the main loop: unless the surface is lost, walks the dirty rectangle list, composes each rectangle through the window stack (0x51D050), draws the cursor, shows the frame time and presents the screen (0x51F8F0). Returns 0 or an error code. Godot draws the screen.

name: compose window stack rectangle
reason: renderer: Recursive compositor: for a dirty rectangle it clips against the visible windows from the top of the z-order, blits the covered parts with their art and colour key, fills uncovered parts black and splits remaining rectangles. Called by 0x51CF40 and 0x4FFAB0. Read in outline.

name: fill window rectangle
reason: renderer: Fills a rectangle of a window's surface with a colour (clipped to the window by 0x52D1A0) and marks it dirty. Called by 40 callers for boxes and clears.

name: draw line in window
reason: renderer: Clips a line to a window (0x52DD00) and draws it in a colour on the window's surface (0x520660), then marks the area dirty. Used for the travel waypoint path on the map.

name: draw rectangle outline in window
reason: renderer: Draws the four sides of a rectangle as four thin fills through 0x51D570. Called by HUD panels and the map.

name: blit art into window
reason: renderer: Blits an art image to a window surface at a point (own size or a given rectangle) with optional colour key, and marks the area dirty. Called by seven interface callers.

name: blit art frame into window
reason: renderer: Draws one frame of an art image into a window with a flag word and marks the dirty area; used by 88 callers for gauges, panels and icons.

name: shift window contents
reason: renderer: Computes the overlapping source and destination rectangles for an offset (dx, dy), copies the window's surface onto itself through the blitter 0x521000 and marks the area dirty; one caller (0x40E630).

name: scroll window contents
reason: renderer: Shifts the contents of a window by an offset using the blitter and marks the vacated strips dirty; used by the scrolling lists (0x563300, 0x563790).

name: copy window to window
reason: renderer: Copies one window's surface into a second window through the blitter 0x521000 and marks it dirty; used by the game view refresh 0x551080.

name: blit surface into window
reason: renderer: Blits a surface rectangle into a window at a point, recursing to split a rectangle, then marks it dirty. Called by speech bubble, tile and HUD callers.

name: copy window surface region
reason: renderer: Copies a rectangle of a window's surface to a caller-given destination through 0x521000; called by the game view refresh 0x551080.

name: draw surface bitmap in window
reason: renderer: Draws a prepared bitmap (via the surface-drawing routine 0x5368B0) onto a window and marks the area dirty. Called by the portrait draw 0x4CE4A0.

name: add red tint to window area
reason: renderer: Clips a rectangle to a window and adds a pure red fill to its pixels (0x523120), marking it dirty. The portrait damage flash in 0x56B290 uses it; the percent rule lives in the caller.

name: draw text in window
reason: renderer: Draws a text string with the current font in a clipped rectangle of a window (0x535570) and marks the area dirty; 51 callers.

name: find free window slot
reason: platform: Scans the table of 0x360-byte window slots from 0x604778 and returns the index of the first slot whose in-use flag is clear, or -1. Called by window create 0x51CB90.

name: window handle to index
reason: other: Identity function: returns its argument; the window handle is the slot index. Called by 28 window functions.

name: window handle identity
reason: other: Identity function returning its argument, used by window create and destroy as a handle conversion.

name: push window on stack
reason: platform: Adds a window handle to the z-order list at 0x60F044 (count 0x60F128), either at the top or below the windows that must stay on top (shifting with 0x58B060). Called by window create and raise.

name: remove window from stack
reason: platform: Removes a window handle from the z-order list 0x60F044 and shrinks the count. Called by window close and raise.

name: mark rectangle dirty
reason: renderer: Clips a rectangle to the screen (0x52D1A0) and adds it to the dirty-rectangle list at 0x60F12C for the next display step. Called by 38 drawing callers.

name: add button to window
reason: platform: Appends a button handle to a window's button array (count at +0x38, array from +0x3C). Called by button create 0x537B50.

name: remove button from window
reason: platform: Removes a button handle from a window's button array and closes the gap. Called by button free 0x537CE0.

name: get window button list
reason: accessor: Returns a window's button count and the address of its button array. Called by 0x537E20 and 0x5380F0.

name: find window at point
reason: platform: Hit test: walks the z-order list from the top and returns the first visible window containing a screen point, skipping a transparent art pixel (0x522F30) when the window has art. Returns the handle or error 0xC. Used by the mouse handling of the buttons and the portraits.

name: dispatch input to windows
reason: platform: Gives an input record (from the queue 0x52BDA0) to the message callbacks of the visible windows from the top down; returns 1 once a window consumed it (a window with flag 4 consumes everything but type 6). Only unconsumed records reach the game loop.

name: raise window to top
reason: platform: Removes a window from the z-order list, pushes it back on top and marks its rectangle dirty. Called by menus and the character editor.

name: show window
reason: platform: Clears a window's hidden flag, marks its rectangle dirty and shows its buttons (0x538900). Called by the HUD and the menus.

name: hide window
reason: platform: Sets a window's hidden flag, marks its rectangle dirty and hides its buttons (0x538980).

name: is window hidden
reason: accessor: Returns the hidden flag (bit 0x20) of a window slot; the bytes after it hold a toggle and a getter of global 0x60F120 (window event handling flag).

name: get window surface
reason: accessor: Writes the surface pointer of a window slot into the caller's output when the window system is up; returns 0x10 for a null output pointer.

name: common dialog box
reason: The modal yes/no/accept dialog: copies the 7-word request, builds a 325 by 136 window with background, text and buttons, then runs its own loop of key events and display until an answer is set in 0x60F040. Used by the quit question 0x5416A0 and others. Our AreaDialogBoxLayout in the terrain viewer (outside the marked assemblies) lays it out; no marked method carries the address.

name: dialog box key handler
