reason: Event handler of the dialog box (window callback): in yes/no kind an upper-cased Y or N key answers, Return and keypad Enter accept, Escape cancels; sets the answer and closes the box. Our viewer's AreaDialogBoxLayout has the letters; no marked method carries the address.

name: close dialog box
reason: Closes the dialog box window (0x51CD30) and clears its handle in 0x5BED98. Nearest ours is the viewer's dialog box host (outside the marked assemblies).

name: draw dialog box background
reason: Draws the dialog box background art into its window, builds the text font and draws the request text in the 30, 14, 265 by 65 rectangle (0x51E190). Nearest ours is AreaDialogBoxLayout in the terrain viewer.

name: build dialog box buttons
reason: Creates the Accept and/or Cancel buttons of the dialog box (art 823 and 824, three frames) at fixed window points by kind (one accept, one cancel, or both). Nearest ours is AreaDialogBoxLayout.Buttons in the terrain viewer.

name: dialog box font init
reason: Loads the dialog box font art (via 0x504330 and 0x5352E0) and clears the two button handles. Nearest ours is AreaDialogBoxLayout (FontArt).

name: release dialog box
reason: Releases the dialog box font (0x535330) and frees its two buttons (0x537CE0). Nearest ours is the viewer's dialog host.

name: run engine init table
reason: startup: Runs the TIG engine library init table (0x5BF2D4 to 0x5BF330) once, reports a failed step by number, then reads the exe path (0x51F290). Called from the entry point 0x401000.

name: run engine shutdown table
reason: startup: Runs the engine shutdown table once and clears the init flag. Called at exit and on fatal errors.

name: engine per iteration ping
reason: platform: Per-frame engine service called at the loop head: refreshes the clock stamp, polls the mouse and keyboard, services the message queue and sound and timer glue (0x52DFA0, 0x4FF390, 0x52B380, 0x52B7B0, 0x5287B0, 0x532DE0). No game rule.

name: engine ping thunk
reason: thunk: Calls the engine ping 0x51F220 and returns; called by the game init 0x4020F0.

name: get exe directory path
reason: accessor: Ensures the exe path is read (0x51F290) and returns a pointer to the directory string (global 0x60F238). Called by file-path helpers.

name: read exe path
reason: platform: Calls GetModuleFileName into 0x60F134, falls back to a default string on failure and keeps the directory part pointer in 0x60F238.

name: set application active flag
reason: platform: Stores the application-active flag from WM_ACTIVATEAPP in 0x60F244 and tells the mouse (0x4FF350) and sound (0x533C90) layers.

name: get application active flag
reason: accessor: Returns the active flag in global 0x60F244.

name: video layer init
reason: startup: Module-table init for the video and cursor layer: sets up display mode values, creates the surfaces (0x524080, 0x524300, 0x5242F0), hides the OS cursor. Never called directly.

name: video layer shutdown
reason: startup: Module-table shutdown for the video layer: releases the surfaces (0x5248F0, 0x5242F0) and clears the video-ready flag 0x61039C.

name: get display surface pointers
reason: accessor: Two tiny getters: the first returns the back-buffer surface pointer (0x60F254), the second (0x51F430) the front surface (0x60F250), when the video layer is up.

name: get primary surface
reason: accessor: Returns the primary surface (0x60F264) when video is up.

name: set cursor rectangle
reason: accessor: Copies a four-field rectangle into the cursor rectangle globals 0x60FEFC to 0x60FF08. Called by the window procedure.

name: draw frame time text
reason: debug: measures time per frame, formats it with a 10.2 float format and draws it onto the primary surface with GDI TextOut. Called by the display step.

name: get surface device context
reason: renderer: Gets a GDI device context for the primary surface (0x525140) once.

name: release surface device context
reason: renderer: Releases the GDI device context of the primary surface (0x525190).

name: draw cursor and save pixels
reason: renderer: Clips the cursor rectangle to the screen, saves the pixels under the software cursor and draws the cursor surface onto the screen surface through DirectDraw calls.

name: restore pixels under cursor
reason: renderer: Clips the cursor rectangle and copies the saved pixels back to the screen surface (0x5251C0), erasing the software cursor.

name: call primary surface method
reason: renderer: Calls one DirectDraw method on the primary surface (0x60F264); thunk used by the present and lost-surface paths.

name: restore lost surface
reason: renderer: If the primary surface is lost, restores it, marks the whole screen dirty (0x51E430) and posts a type-8 record at the head of the input queue (0x52B890). Called by the display step.

name: present frame
reason: renderer: Presents the frame: blits the back buffer or the dirty rectangle to the primary surface through DirectDraw calls and handles a lost surface (0x525430). Called after each display step.

name: start video and input layers
reason: startup: Entry point step: creates the cursor and input state (0x52B920), stores handles and starts the surface layer (0x525250); the second part is its shutdown pair.

name: get screen rectangle
reason: accessor: Copies the stored display rectangle (0x610388 to 0x610394) to the caller when video is up; returns 1 otherwise. Called by the window procedure.

name: get colour depth
reason: accessor: Returns the screen colour depth (global 0x61030C) when video is up.

name: get pixel format masks
reason: accessor: Returns the red green blue pixel masks of the screen format (0x60FF0C table) for modes deeper than 8 bits. Called by the surface drawing routine 0x5368B0.

name: three-d device check
reason: renderer: Returns 0 when a Direct3D device is present (global 0x61031c) and 16 when not, 1 if the 3D layer itself is off (global 0x61039c); used by the tile and light module setup. Our prototype builder only sets the device global to none.

name: hardware three-d check
reason: renderer: Same shape as 0x51FB10 but tests global 0x610320 (hardware 3D flag); returns 0 or 16, 1 if the 3D layer is off. Called by the library init.

name: begin three-d scene
reason: renderer: Calls the 3D device begin-scene method (global 0x60f270) once and sets the in-scene flag 0x610358; returns 0 on success, 16 on failure. Called by the 0x4046F0 and 0x404740 frame wrappers.

name: end three-d scene
reason: renderer: Counterpart of 0x51FB50: calls the 3D device end-scene method and clears flag 0x610358; returns 0 or 16.

name: query free video memory
reason: renderer: Asks DirectDraw (global 0x60f258) for total and free video memory and stores both through two out pointers; logs a failure. Called from the library init 0x500590.

name: gamma support check
reason: renderer: Returns 0 if a gamma control object exists (global 0x60f2f4), else 16. Callers use it to decide whether the gamma fade and brightness option work.

name: gamma ramp fade
reason: renderer: Fades the screen gamma ramp from the current ramp to a target (flat ramp, or the table 0x60F8F8) in N steps over a time, waiting on the clock each step; used by the fades 0x4BDFA0 and the setter 0x51FFE0. Pure presentation: the step count and duration are read in docs/research/ledger/ui-audio.md PD9; Godot fades with its own code.

name: read gamma ramp
reason: renderer: Reads the current hardware gamma ramp (three 256-entry 16-bit tables) into a caller buffer and, if all high bytes are empty, shifts the bytes up. Helper of 0x51FCA0.

name: write gamma ramp
reason: renderer: Normalises a three-table 16-bit ramp (copies the high byte into both halves) and hands it to the gamma control object; returns 0 or 16. Helper of 0x51FCA0.

name: set gamma brightness
reason: renderer: Rejects values outside the open range between two float limits (returns 12), scales the base table 0x60F8F8 into the live ramp (capped at 0xFF00), stores the factor in global 0x60FEF8 and applies it with a one-step 0x51FCA0 call. The brightness slider of the options screen calls it; the visual effect is replaced by Godot.

name: create art surface
reason: renderer: Allocates a 0xB0-byte surface record, fills a DirectDraw surface description (video or system memory, 3D texture, power-of-two size, colour key and primary flags) with several fallbacks, creates the surface via 0x524FD0 and records size and flags. 23 callers (art cache, windows, tiles).

name: free art surface
reason: renderer: Releases the COM surface of a surface record (0x525120), clears the global current-texture 0x610334 if it was this one, and frees the record; returns 0, or 16 for a null pointer.

name: get surface info
reason: renderer: Copies the flag, size, pitch and colour-depth fields of a surface record into a caller structure; returns 16 for null. Many callers, no game rule.

name: set surface color key
reason: renderer: Sets the source colour key of a keyed surface (DDraw SetColorKey with one colour) and stores it in the record; returns 16 for a surface without the key flag or on failure.

name: lock art surface
reason: renderer: Reference-counted lock of a surface record: the first lock calls 0x525140 to get the bit pointer and pitch and flags the record locked; returns 7 when locking fails.

name: unlock art surface
reason: renderer: Counterpart of 0x5204B0: decrements the lock count and unlocks the DirectDraw surface when it reaches zero.

name: fill surface rectangle
reason: renderer: Fills one rectangle of a surface record with a colour through the colour-fill blit 0x5251C0; returns 0 or 16. Used by floaters, speech bubbles and light drawing.

name: draw surface line
reason: renderer: Locks a surface and draws a clipped line (integer line stepping, with a step or thickness count) between two points in one colour, for each pixel depth; returns 7 if the lock fails. Only caller is the path or waypoint line drawing 0x51D6B0 (the which-points rule lives in that caller). Read in outline.

name: hardware blit support test
reason: renderer: Decides whether a blit with the given flag bits can use the hardware path: true for no flags, otherwise needs a 3D device and a surface marked as hardware texture. Called from the art blit 0x502360.

name: stretching surface blit
reason: renderer: Copies a source rectangle to a destination rectangle of another surface with scaling, colour key and blend options, in 8, 16, 24 and 32 bit paths and also through the Direct3D textured quad path (0x526450, 0x526530). Our AreaInventoryHole comment cites it for the half-scale copy only. Read in outline.

name: read surface pixel
reason: renderer: Reads one pixel at an x y position of a surface record (bounds check returns 12) for 8, 16, 24 or 32 bit depth. Called from the portrait helper 0x51E690.

name: blended rectangle fill
reason: renderer: Fills a rectangle of a locked surface with a colour at a blend mode below 4 (translucent shade), skipping the fill when it equals the key colour in mode 3; separate loops for each depth. Called by the follower portrait fill 0x51E0A0 and 0x4C9BE0; the highlight rule belongs to those callers. Read in outline.

name: save surface to bitmap
reason: renderer: Locks a surface, reads its size and clip rectangle and writes the area to a bitmap file through 0x525ED0; returns the file-writer's result. Callers 0x404010 and the terrain helper 0x4E7E80 (debug or screenshot style output).

name: load bitmap into surface
reason: renderer: Opens a bitmap file, reads the file and info headers (accepts uncompressed 8 and 24 bit, flips bottom-up rows), builds a surface through 0x5200F0 and copies the pixels converting to the screen depth; refuses when screen depth is 8. Used by 0x404270, 0x404830 and 0x5630F0 for interface images. Read in outline.

name: register window class
reason: platform: Registers the engine window class and icon, loads the menu resource and creates the main game window with adjusted client size (strings for class, icon and menu names). Called from the start-up 0x51F330.

name: clear display state flag
reason: startup: Sets global 0x60F254 to zero; called by the library start-up 0x51F330 and shut-down 0x51F3F0.

name: start display library
reason: platform: Initialises DirectDraw: logs, creates the object, checks 3D caps, picks the display mode and surfaces through 0x524480 or 0x524640, reads the pixel format (0x524830), enumerates 3D devices (0x524930) and builds the palette (0x524F00); returns a failure code. Called once from 0x51F330.

name: set fullscreen display mode
reason: renderer: Sets exclusive cooperative level and display mode, creates the primary surface (and back surface) through 0x524FD0 and attaches them to the global display state. Part of display start-up.

name: set windowed display mode
reason: renderer: Windowed variant of display set-up: reads the desktop depth, shows 'Invalid Desktop Settings' by message box for an unsupported depth and creates the primary and off-screen surfaces. Part of display start-up.

name: detect pixel format
reason: renderer: Probes the screen pixel layout up to 50 times (SetPixel and GetPixel probe via 0x525350, then the surface pixel format) and feeds the channel masks to 0x52C070 to build the colour tables; the tables are read at 0x739EA0 and 0x739EA4.

name: shut down display library
reason: platform: Release path of the display start-up: calls two release helpers (0x524EF0 empty, 0x524FC0 palette release). Called from 0x51F3F0.

name: enumerate three-d devices
reason: renderer: Queries the Direct3D 7 interface, looks for reference, hardware and RGB software devices in that order, logging each, and keeps the chosen device and its z-buffer or texture format; failure leaves 3D off.

name: accept z-buffer format callback
reason: renderer: Address-taken callback (no direct callers) that validates a 32-byte pixel-format record (size at least 16, matching a requested depth, not 0xF000) and copies it into global 0x610338; returns 0 to stop or 1 to continue. Enumeration callback of the 3D device set-up.

name: empty release step
reason: stub: Just returns; the first release helper called by 0x5248F0.

name: build default palette
reason: renderer: Fills a 256-entry palette table via the colour helpers 0x52C310, 0x52C330 and 0x52C350, creates the DirectDraw palette and attaches it to the primary surface (palette handle in global 0x60F268).

name: release palette
reason: renderer: Releases the DirectDraw palette object held in global 0x60F268 if there is one.

name: create display surface
reason: renderer: Creates a DirectDraw surface from a description (width, height, flags) and stores the interface pointer; on failure logs and frees via 0x525120, returns 0 or 1. Helper of 0x5200F0 and the display set-up.

name: release surface object
reason: renderer: Calls Release on the interface held at a pointer and nulls the pointer. Helper of 0x520390 and 0x524FD0.

name: lock display surface
reason: renderer: Calls DirectDraw Lock on a surface with a description of size 0x7C and returns the bit pointer through an out parameter; logs a failure code via 0x525430 and returns 1 or 0.

name: unlock display surface
reason: renderer: Calls DirectDraw Unlock on a surface with the stored bit pointer; logs failures; returns 1 or 0.

name: color fill blit
reason: renderer: Fills a rectangle on a DirectDraw surface using the colour-fill blit with wait flag; logs failures; returns 1 or 0. Used by 0x520630.

name: save screenshot file
reason: renderer: Hot-key callback (address taken): when the key matches it finds the first unused screen number name pattern in the working folder, locks the screen surface and writes the full screen as a bitmap through 0x525ED0.

name: probe pixel colour
reason: renderer: Writes a probe colour with GDI SetPixel on the desktop DC and reads it back to learn how the display stores it; used by the pixel-format detect 0x524830.

name: decode display error code
reason: debug: Maps a DirectDraw error code to its name text and logs it through 0x4FEB70; long compare chain; called by the surface and display wrappers.

name: write surface to bitmap
reason: renderer: Writes a rectangle of a locked surface to a bitmap file (file header, info header, rows bottom-up, 8 or 16 or 24 bit depth with colour conversion). Callers 0x523930 and 0x525250 (screenshots). Read in outline.

name: select three-d texture
reason: renderer: Sets the current Direct3D texture on stage 0 (global 0x610334 tracks it) and sets a texture transform; logs the outcome; returns 0 or 16. Called by the stretching blit 0x521000.

name: compute texture rectangle
reason: renderer: Computes the texture coordinates of a sub-rectangle for the hardware textured-quad blit, scaling the source rectangle onto the destination and storing four byte values. Helper of 0x521000.

name: quad corner color interpolation
reason: renderer: re-interpolates the four corner colors of a textured quad (vertex colors as bytes) across a sub-rectangle given by two rectangles and an output array of four packed colors; floating point bilinear stepping. Called only from 0x521000.

name: socket set membership thunk
reason: thunk: forwards two arguments to the WinSock set-membership function pointer 0x612530 loaded by the network layer.

name: empty slot hook
reason: stub: empty function that returns at once; called with a slot pointer by the network teardown and discovery code.

name: player slot is active
reason: multiplayer: tests bit 0x1 of the flag word of player slot n in the slot array at 0x6188B8 (stride 0x2070 bytes); 26 callers all in network code.

name: slot is local player
reason: multiplayer: answers whether a slot number equals the local player slot stored at global 0x614848.

name: slot is active and flagged
reason: multiplayer: answers bit 0x2 of the slot flag word when the slot is active (0x526AE0), else zero.

name: player slot name pointer
reason: multiplayer: returns the address of the name field of an active slot; for an inactive slot it logs a message and returns the text INACTIVE.

name: set player slot name
reason: multiplayer: copies up to 23 characters of a name into two name fields of slot n and returns 1; the bytes after it hold three unlisted helpers that derive an average from slot counters via 0x526CF0/0x526CD0/0x526CB0.

name: slot counter b getter
reason: accessor: returns the dword at offset 0x2050 of a player slot (a traffic counter used by the slot statistics).

name: slot counter a getter
reason: accessor: returns the dword at offset 0x204C of a player slot (a traffic counter used by the slot statistics).

name: slot elapsed time
reason: multiplayer: returns the milliseconds since the time stamp kept in a slot (via 0x52DFB0).

name: reset slot time stamp
reason: multiplayer: zeroes the nine dwords of a slot statistics block, stamps the current time into the first (0x52DFA0) and returns 1.

name: slot lag flag update
reason: multiplayer: when the time since a slot was last heard from exceeds 1400 ms it sets flag 0x10 and raises event 2 through callback 0x62AC54, and clears the flag with event 3 when the delay falls back; returns the delay.

name: clear network mode bits
reason: multiplayer: clears bits 0x1, 0x2 and 0x8 (network active, host, client admitted) of the network state word 0x62AC6C; called from the network shutdown 0x5280F0.

name: format dotted ip address
reason: multiplayer: formats a 32-bit address into text a.b.c.d; used by discovery, bookmark and join code.

name: parse dotted ip address
reason: multiplayer: calls the WinSock address parser 0x61255C on a string and stores the 32-bit result, answering 0 when it is not a valid address.

name: network layer reset and init
reason: multiplayer: logs, resets all eight slots and the local slot, clears sockets, sets the default server and player names Arcanum and Player, resets the timer and the state word; reached through a function pointer only.

name: reset one player slot
reason: multiplayer: sets a slot to unused (id -1), clears its 8 KB buffer and sets buffer pointers and size 0x2000.

name: network layer initialise
reason: multiplayer: same reset as 0x526E60 plus freeing the old buffer and clearing the state word; called from the network start 0x5287B0.

name: network layer shut down
reason: multiplayer: saves the bookmark file, clears every slot, frees the buffers and resets the state word; reached through a function pointer only.

name: empty per slot hook
reason: stub: empty function (ret) called per active slot during network shutdown.

name: unload winsock library
reason: multiplayer: calls WSACleanup and frees the loaded winsock library, returns 1.

name: start network host or lan
reason: multiplayer: starts the network layer (load winsock, read bookmarks, host mode sets the server socket address, start discovery 0x527BD0); returns 0xE on failure; called by network start 0x49CBD0.

name: set network active bit
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 0x1 (network active) of the state word 0x62AC6C.

name: load winsock library
reason: multiplayer: loads ws2_32.dll, else wsock32.dll, resolves WSAStartup, starts version 2.0 or 1.1 and binds the function tables (0x5273B0, 0x527720).

name: bind winsock functions one
reason: multiplayer: resolves about 45 base WinSock entry points by name into global pointers at 0x612530..0x6125E8.

name: bind winsock functions two
reason: multiplayer: resolves the WinSock 2 extension entry points by name into global pointers (0x6125EC and following).

name: mark player slot used
reason: multiplayer: sets the used bit 0x1 and stores its own number as the id of player slot n.

name: find local host address
reason: multiplayer: prepares the listening address structure 0x612508 with port 31435, asks the local host name and its first address, formats it into the log; returns 0xE when the name cannot be resolved.

name: init slot statistics block
reason: multiplayer: zeroes an 81-dword block, sets a limit of 8 and 50 in it and stamps the time; used by network init and bookmark code.

name: lan discovery socket and host listen
reason: multiplayer: creates the UDP broadcast discovery socket, registers asynchronous events, sets broadcast option, binds and reads the local broadcast mask; the same function body also contains the host listen setup 0x527E80 (TCP port 31435, backlog 5, no-delay).

name: set network host bit
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 0x2 (this machine is the host) of the state word 0x62AC6C.

name: close network sockets
reason: multiplayer: closes every used slot socket and the listening and discovery sockets, unloads the winsock library (0x527180) and clears the mode bits (0x526E00); called by network stop 0x49CC20.

name: join listed server
reason: multiplayer: builds a join packet (type 0x19) with the player name and extra data and connects to a server chosen from the lobby list through 0x5282A0, then sends it (0x529830); called by the lobby window 0x5883E0.

name: connect to host socket
reason: multiplayer: client side, announces event 4, creates a TCP socket for the given server address, connects, sets no-delay and returns 1; logs and returns 0 on failure.

name: join by typed address
reason: multiplayer: direct join to a typed address; a host name that is not a dotted address is never resolved and the join packet is sent without a connection, a known original bug (NT9).

name: text is digits and dots
reason: multiplayer: answers 1 when every character of a string is a digit or a dot; used by the direct join.

name: leave network game
reason: multiplayer: host sends a quit packet to every active slot, closes all sockets and slots; a client with admitted slot sends one request (type 5) to the host, else just closes its socket; returns 1.

name: set game running bit
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 0x4 (a game is running) of the network state word 0x62AC6C and raises event 11 through callback 0x62AC54.

name: set network event callback
reason: callback slot: stores the network event callback pointer in global 0x62AC54.

name: set network callback b
reason: accessor: stores one argument in global 0x62AC58 (a network callback; the function body also holds a twin setter for 0x62AC5C).

name: set discovery callback
reason: accessor: stores one argument in global 0x62AC60 (a lobby list callback).

name: set network callback c
reason: accessor: stores one argument in global 0x62AC64.

name: set auto join bit
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 0x10 (auto-join) of the network state word 0x62AC6C.

name: clear auto join bit
reason: multiplayer: clears bit 0x10 (auto-join) of the network state word 0x62AC6C.

name: auto join bit test
reason: multiplayer: returns bit 0x10 (auto-join) of the network state word 0x62AC6C.

name: network pause count up
reason: multiplayer: increments counter 0x62AC4C that blocks the network pump; called from 0x51EA60.

name: network pause count down
reason: multiplayer: decrements counter 0x62AC4C that blocks the network pump; called from 0x51EA60.

name: network pump per frame
reason: multiplayer: per-frame network pump called from the window loop 0x51F220; polls sockets, on the host broadcasts a heartbeat packet (type 7) every 350 ms and a discovery broadcast every 5 s, on a client queries the lobby list; also updates slot lag flags.

name: client broadcast server query
reason: multiplayer: on a client builds a type 0x19 discovery request packet with the local address and sends it by UDP to the stored broadcast address; called by the connect function 0x529C20.

name: poll sockets for data
reason: multiplayer: builds the list of active slot sockets (host) or the single client socket, polls them with the WinSock select pointer and calls the receive handler 0x528B70 for each readable socket.

name: receive from socket
reason: multiplayer: reads pending bytes from a player socket into the slot buffer, handles would-block and connection reset, splits complete packets with 0x529A80 and 0x529B80 and compacts the buffer; drops the slot when the buffer is full.

name: find slot by socket
reason: multiplayer: returns the address of the slot that owns a socket (the local slot for a client), or 0.

name: drop player connection
reason: multiplayer: closes the socket of a slot, raises event 8 and event 9 through callback 0x62AC54 and resets the slot to unused.

name: socket event handler udp
reason: multiplayer: handles an asynchronous socket event message by event number through a jump table; for a read event on the broadcast socket receives a datagram and passes it to 0x529C20.

name: socket window message dispatch
reason: multiplayer: dispatches the asynchronous socket message (accept, read, close) to 0x5290E0, 0x528B70 or 0x528DD0; while the pump is blocked it re-posts the message with PostMessage.

name: accept incoming connection
reason: multiplayer: host accepts a new client socket, assigns a free slot via 0x5292B0 and 0x527AC0, or sends a refusal packet and closes when no slot is free.

name: find free player slot
reason: multiplayer: returns the first unused slot number below the maximum player count (0x529330), or -1 when all are used; called when accepting a connection.

name: set server name
reason: accessor: copies a name of up to 23 characters into the server name buffer at 0x6123D7 (the function body after the setter also covers neighbouring name globals); called by module init and reset.

name: set maximum players
reason: multiplayer: stores the host's player limit in global 0x6123FC when it is 1..8 and returns 1, else returns 0; read by 0x529330.

name: get maximum players
reason: accessor: returns the player limit stored in global 0x6123FC.

name: set local player name
reason: accessor: copies 23 characters into the local player name buffer at 0x61484C and returns 1; a following getter returns that address.

name: set server display name
reason: accessor: copies 23 characters of a server name into buffer 0x6123C0.

name: get server display name
reason: accessor: copies the server name buffer 0x6123C0 out to a caller buffer (length given); a neighbouring getter returns its address.

name: set game password
reason: multiplayer: frees the old password string 0x62AC38 and clears option bit 0x8, then duplicates a non-empty new one and sets option bit 0x8 (password required).

name: get password length
reason: accessor: returns the length of the password string at global 0x62AC38, 0 when unset.

name: clear game password
reason: multiplayer: clears the password by calling 0x5293C0 with no string.

name: get level range
reason: accessor: copies the host's minimum and maximum character level (globals 0x6123F4 and 0x6123F8) to two optional output pointers.

name: set level range
reason: accessor: stores the minimum and maximum level of a hosted game in 0x6123F4 and 0x6123F8 after clamping the minimum to the maximum; ignores negative or zero input.

name: get game type
reason: accessor: copies the advertised game type (global 0x6123F0) to an output pointer.

name: set game type
reason: accessor: stores the advertised game type in global 0x6123F0.

name: get server option bits
reason: accessor: returns the server option word 0x61241C (player killing 1, friendly fire 2, private chat 4, password 8); read by the damage veto 0x4A6190 among others.

name: set server option bits
reason: accessor: ors the given mask into the server option word 0x61241C.

name: clear server option bits
reason: accessor: clears the given mask in the server option word 0x61241C.

name: local player slot number
reason: multiplayer: returns the local player slot (global 0x614848) when this machine is the host (state bit 0x2), else 0; many network callers.

name: send tagged packet
reason: multiplayer: wraps a short payload with the packet header (type 0x19, length), refuses sizes above 8 KB and sends it to one slot (host) or to the host (client); used by the sector and party code of the TIG layer.

name: send message to everyone
reason: multiplayer: wraps a buffer into a packet (type 0x19, subtype 3); on a host sends it to every active slot 1..7 that is not excluded by the 0x4 flag test, on a client sends it to the host; 183 callers in game code.

name: send message to all but one
reason: multiplayer: like 0x5295F0 but skips one named slot (the sender); a client sends to the host.

name: send message to one slot
reason: multiplayer: wraps a buffer into a packet and sends it to one named slot via 0x529790.

name: low level send to slot
reason: multiplayer: stamps the packet header, adds the byte count to the slot and host traffic counters, sends through 0x529870 and drops the slot when the send fails.

name: low level send to host
reason: multiplayer: client side send of one packet to the server socket 0x612518; on failure clears the socket and drops the connection.

name: send bytes on socket
reason: multiplayer: logs the packet via 0x529920 and sends all bytes on a socket, retrying on would-block; on a hard error closes the socket and drops the connection.

name: packet trace and callback
reason: multiplayer: validates a packet header and traces it by packet subtype through a jump table; for subtype 1 and 4 can call the network packet callback 0x62AC64.

name: check packet header
reason: multiplayer: validates a received net packet header (type byte must be 0x19, size field between 1 and 0x2000), logs an error otherwise and returns 0 or 1; called by the packet-available test 0x529A80 and 0x529920.

name: packet fully buffered test
reason: multiplayer: tells whether one whole packet sits in the receive buffer of a player slot (or of the own buffer, slot equal to global 0x614848), validating the header with 0x529A00; used by the network pump 0x528B70.

name: consume received packet
reason: multiplayer: hands the next buffered packet of a player slot to the packet dispatcher 0x529C20 (setting the current-sender global 0x5C064C meanwhile) and advances the receive buffer by the packet size; called by 0x528B70.

name: net packet dispatcher
reason: multiplayer: large switch over TIG net packet sub-types (join request and answer, player list, host announcement, bookmark and server list updates, chat, leave, admit, pause and the like) that updates player slots and the network state word 0x62AC6C and calls the host callbacks; read in outline only, no single-player rule.

name: set player slot state
reason: multiplayer: stores an argument into the state word of a network player slot (array at 0x6188D4); only caller is the packet dispatcher.

name: stamp player slot
reason: multiplayer: writes a clock reading (0x52DFA0) and an argument into a network player slot record; called by the packet dispatcher.

name: mark client admitted
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 0x8 (client admitted) in the network state word 0x62AC6C; called by the packet dispatcher.

name: clear slot active bit
reason: multiplayer: clears bit 1 of the state word of a network player slot; called by the packet dispatcher.

name: copy player record
reason: multiplayer: copies a network player record (id, 23 byte name, one more field) from one buffer to another; called by the packet dispatcher.

name: current sender accessor
reason: multiplayer: returns global 0x5C064C, the player slot whose packet is being dispatched; rule lives in the callers (all network code).

name: broadcast host announcement
reason: multiplayer: when the network is on, hosting and not disabled, builds a 0x14C byte host-information packet (player count, clock divided by 1000) and sends it to the broadcast address with the socket send pointer 0x612580, logging the error text on failure; called by 0x5287B0.

name: update server list entry
reason: multiplayer: looks a host up in the discovered-server list 0x612520, flags it as a bookmark when its info says so, refreshes it, then calls the list-changed callback 0x62AC60 with a snapshot made by 0x52A890; called by the packet dispatcher.

name: expire old servers
reason: multiplayer: removes from the discovered-server list every entry older than 10000 ms (callback 0x52A750 queues them on list 0x62AC84) and frees them; called by 0x5287B0.

name: server entry age test
reason: multiplayer: list-enumeration callback that queues an entry for removal when its time stamp is more than 10000 ms old; only reached through the table in 0x52A6E0.

name: set server filter bits
reason: multiplayer: ORs bits into the server-browser filter mask global 0x5C0648; called by the lobby window 0x5862D0.

name: clear server filter bits
reason: multiplayer: clears bits in the server-browser filter mask global 0x5C0648 (a getter of the mask follows it in padding); called by the lobby window 0x5862D0.

name: server list filter callback
reason: multiplayer: list-enumeration callback that, when the filter mask 0x5C0648 allows an entry (game type, protected flag), copies its 0x144 byte record into the snapshot array and counts it; only reached through table pointers.

name: snapshot server list
reason: multiplayer: allocates and fills an array copy of the discovered-server list 0x612520 filtered by 0x52A7F0 and returns pointer and count; called by the lobby windows and the dispatcher.

name: any player paused test
reason: multiplayer: when the network is active and no lock counter 0x62AC88 is held, tests the 8 player slots for a paused one and returns 1 if any; in single player it returns 0 (used by the pause test 0x45B300).

name: lock counter increment
reason: multiplayer: increments the counter 0x62AC88 that suppresses the paused-player test during map transfer; called by the multiplayer module start and map open.

name: lock counter decrement
reason: multiplayer: decrements the counter 0x62AC88; counterpart of 0x52A940.

name: count connected players
reason: multiplayer: counts player slots 0..7 for which the connection test 0x526AE0 holds; called by the host announcement code.

name: set slot ready bit
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 2 of the state word of a network player slot; called by the network event handler 0x4A2070 and the roster sender.

name: clear slot ready bit
reason: multiplayer: clears bit 2 of the state word of a network player slot; called by the packet dispatcher 0x49D690.

name: handle player disconnect
reason: multiplayer: for a player slot that had bit 4 set, either reports a paused game or clears the bit, tells the other players (packet type 2, name from 0x526B50) and fires the player-left callbacks 0x62AC54; called by the timer event and the dispatcher.

name: slot state accessor
reason: multiplayer: returns the state word of a network player slot; only caller 0x52A9E0.

name: send player roster
reason: multiplayer: builds a 0x10C byte roster packet (names, flags and ids of the 8 slots plus two globals) and sends it to a given player with 0x529790; called by the disconnect handler.

name: set slot bit 4
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 4 of the state word of a network player slot; called from 0x5290E0.

name: clear slot bit 4
reason: multiplayer: clears bit 4 of the state word of a network player slot; called by 0x52A9E0.

name: slot bit 4 test
reason: multiplayer: returns bit 4 of the state word of a network player slot; used by many network functions and by the script-authority path in the docs.

name: mark slot admitted
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 8 of a network player slot and calls the socket pointer 0x612588 with the slot's handle and 1; called by the pump and the dispatcher.

name: slot status helpers
reason: multiplayer: a group of tiny lobby helpers (bit 8 test, bit 0x10 test, status text choosing Waiting to Join or Playing by bit 4, clear a four-word block); called by the network pump 0x528B70.

name: log player address
reason: multiplayer: formats a player slot's IPv4 address with 0x526E10 and appends it to a text list with 0x53AB90; called by the lobby window 0x570BC0.

name: set network disabled bit
reason: multiplayer: sets bit 0x20 (network disabled) in the state word 0x62AC6C, with a clearing twin after it in padding; called once from the engine startup 0x401000.

name: load bookmark file
reason: multiplayer: opens the bookmark file, reads each non-comment line, resolves the address and adds it to the discovered-server list flagged as bookmark; called by 0x5271D0.

name: save bookmark file
reason: multiplayer: opens the bookmark file for writing and enumerates the server list with 0x52AF70 so every bookmarked host is written; called by 0x5270C0.

name: write bookmark line
reason: multiplayer: list-enumeration callback that writes the address of an entry flagged as bookmark to the bookmark file followed by a line break; only reachable through the table in 0x52AF20.

name: add bookmark
reason: multiplayer: finds or creates a server-list entry for an address, flags it as bookmark and sets the bookmarks-changed global 0x62AC48; called by the lobby window 0x588650.

name: remove bookmark
reason: multiplayer: clears the bookmark flag of a server-list entry, resets its age and sets the bookmarks-changed global 0x62AC48; called by the lobby window 0x5887F0.

name: copy local address
reason: multiplayer: copies the four words of the local network address block at 0x612404 to a caller buffer; callers are in the lobby windows.

name: send host announcement reply
reason: multiplayer: builds a 0x14C byte game-info packet (own host data when hosting, else zeroed with the saved fields) and sends it with the socket pointers 0x612558 and 0x612580; called by the dispatcher and the lobby window 0x588990.

name: set lobby callback
reason: multiplayer: stores its argument into global 0x62AC68; called by lobby window 0x585D50.

name: socket call thunk
reason: multiplayer: calls the function pointer 0x612568 with one argument (a twin in padding calls 0x612554); called by lobby window 0x588990.

name: stamp network clock
reason: multiplayer: stores a clock reading (0x52DFA0) at global 0x612420; called once by the module start 0x49CC70.

name: send pong packet
reason: multiplayer: builds an 8 byte packet of sub-type 7 and sends it to a player slot through the send pointer 0x61257C; called by the network event handler 0x4A2070.

name: send ping packet
reason: multiplayer: builds an 8 byte packet of sub-type 8 and sends it to a player slot through the send pointer 0x61257C; called by the network event handler 0x4A2070.

name: network counter increment
reason: multiplayer: increments global 0x62AC50; called by the dispatcher.

name: network counter decrement
reason: multiplayer: decrements global 0x62AC50 (a setter of 0x62AC3C follows in padding); called by the dispatcher.

name: start keyboard device
reason: platform: public entry that starts the DirectInput keyboard once (error 2 when already started, 7 when 0x52B580 fails); reached only through the library table.

name: stop keyboard device
reason: platform: releases the DirectInput keyboard through 0x52B6A0 when started; reached only through the library table.

name: held key state
reason: accessor: returns the high bit of the held-key table entry for a scan code (table 0x62B09C); the rules (always run, weapon art choice) live in the callers.

name: lock key toggle state
reason: accessor: returns the toggle state of Caps Lock (0x62AC90), Scroll Lock (0x62AC94) or Num Lock (0x62B098) by scan code 0x3A, 0x46, 0x45 and zero otherwise; the always-run rule using it is in 0x4304C0.

name: keyboard poll
reason: platform: reads buffered DirectInput keyboard data, updates the held-key table 0x62B09C, posts key down and up events with 0x52B890 (modifier handling for Alt and Ctrl) and flips the Caps, Scroll and Num Lock toggles on key press; called from the engine ping 0x51F220.

name: start direct input keyboard
reason: platform: reads the three lock-key states with GetKeyState, creates the DirectInput keyboard device with data format, cooperative level and 64 entry buffer and acquires it; reached from 0x52B2F0.

name: release keyboard device
reason: platform: unacquires and releases the DirectInput keyboard object in global 0x62B19C.

name: start message queue
reason: platform: initialises the event queue critical section, clears the queue heads, stores the window message hook and window mode flag; reached only through the library table.

name: free message queue
reason: platform: frees the pending and free event lists and deletes the queue critical section; reached only through the library table.

name: message pump ping
reason: platform: posts the per-frame tick event (type 6), runs the registered held-key callbacks, then peeks one Windows message and translates and dispatches it (a quit message posts a quit event); called by 0x51F220.

name: post input event
reason: platform: copies an input event record into a pooled node and appends it to the queue under the queue lock when the event filter 0x52BF90 allows it; the single entry point of all keyboard, mouse and tick events.

name: register held key callback
reason: platform: adds or removes an entry (scan code and callback) in a table of 16 held-key callbacks that 0x52B7B0 runs once per tick; called by 0x51F9E0.

name: main window procedure
reason: platform: window procedure translating Windows messages to engine events (client rectangle and move, paint, activate-app to 0x51F300, mouse buttons and wheel to the mouse helpers 0x4FF3B0 and 0x4FF410, character to a type 4 event, close, network socket messages 0x401 and 0x402 to the network layer) and forwarding the rest to a hook or DefWindowProc.

name: set window message hook
reason: accessor: stores its argument in global 0x62B270, the hook the window procedure calls for messages it does not handle; called by 0x51F330.

name: fetch next input event
reason: Takes the next queued event under the queue lock, offers it first to 0x5317C0 and 0x538220 (key shortcuts) and the window system 0x51E790 (which can consume it, tick events pass), and returns the first unconsumed event or empty (code 10); this event ownership order (windows before game view) is not carried by any method of ours, our Godot viewer routes input by scene instead.

name: post exit request
reason: platform: posts an event of type 3 (exit request) with a timestamp and a reason argument; called from many game-exit paths; the padding after it holds small flag setters for the queue filter 0x62B1EC.

name: take event node
reason: library: pops an event node from the free list (refilling it with 0x52BF10 when empty) under the queue lock.

name: refill event node pool
reason: library: when the free list is empty allocates 33 nodes of 32 bytes and chains them into it.

name: return event node
reason: library: pushes an event node back on the free list under the queue lock; called by 0x52BDA0.

name: event accept test
reason: platform: event filter of the queue; with the filter flag 0x62B1EC set everything is accepted, otherwise it rejects mouse events (type 0) other than sub-type 6 and rejects type 5 events; called by 0x52B890.

name: select colour mode
reason: renderer: for a pixel depth argument copies one row of three colour-mask tables (per 8 bit group) into the active tables and remembers the depth in global 0x62B29C once; reached only through the library table.

name: free colour tables
reason: renderer: frees the colour conversion lookup tables built by 0x52C070 and clears the ready flag; reached only through the library table.

name: init colour conversion
reason: renderer: from the screen's red, green and blue masks computes the shifts and bit counts and builds the lookup tables of the window library's colour conversion; called by 0x524830.

name: set pixel masks
reason: renderer: stores the display's four channel masks and derives shifts, widths and maxima for each; called by 0x524930.

name: get green channel layout
reason: renderer: returns three words of the green channel layout (shift, width, mask) from the tables at 0x5C2198; called by 0x5360F0 (a similar red getter sits in padding before it).

name: pixel red channel
reason: renderer: thunk to 0x52C760 with channel 0 and mode 0, extracts the red component of a pixel.

name: pixel green channel
reason: renderer: thunk to 0x52C760 with channel 1 and mode 0, extracts the green component of a pixel.

name: pixel blue channel
reason: renderer: thunk to 0x52C760 with channel 2 and mode 0, extracts the blue component of a pixel.

name: pixel grey conversion
reason: renderer: converts one screen pixel to grey by summing three per-channel lookup tables and repacking (padding after it holds two further pixel converters); called by the icon and spell-icon drawing 0x523120 and 0x533EC0. Our viewer greys icons in InterfaceHd.Greyed with plain luminance weights (ledger CHW21).

name: pixel red alt mode
reason: renderer: thunk to 0x52C760 with channel 0 and mode 3, a variant red extraction.

name: pixel green alt mode
reason: renderer: thunk to 0x52C760 with channel 1 and mode 3.

name: pixel blue alt mode
reason: renderer: thunk to 0x52C760 with channel 2 and mode 3.

name: pixel format conversion
reason: renderer: converts a palette colour word into the screen's pixel format through the lookup tables; our PrototypeBuilder answers it with a hook, the Godot drawing has no such step.

name: pack clamped colour
reason: renderer: clamps three 0..255 components and scales them into the screen's channel widths and shifts to one pixel word; called by 0x524F00 and 0x535D80.

name: set channel mask
reason: renderer: for one colour channel stores a mask and derives its shift and maximum (or copies the 8 bit defaults); called by 0x52C070.

name: extract channel value
reason: renderer: masks a pixel for one channel and mode, shifts it down and scales to 0..255; in 8 bit mode inverts a positive value; shared by the channel thunks.

name: build blend tables
reason: renderer: allocates and fills the square blend lookup table sized by the colour maximum; called by 0x52C070.

name: free blend tables
reason: renderer: frees the blend tables built by 0x52C7C0 (guarding shared pointers).

name: build channel scale tables
reason: renderer: allocates and fills the per-value scale lookup table for one colour channel; called by 0x52C070.

name: free channel scale tables
reason: renderer: frees the lookup tables built by 0x52C9B0 and 0x52CB20; called by 0x52C040.

name: build channel expand tables
reason: renderer: allocates and fills the 256 entry expansion tables for green and blue; called by 0x52C070.

name: free colour ramp tables
reason: renderer: frees the six byte lookup tables (globals 0x739EBC/0x739EC0/0x739EA0 and 0x739E98/0x739F28/0x739F2C) built for the display colour channels, skipping pointers shared between them and nulling each. Called by 0x52C040 and 0x52CB20 (display mode change and shutdown).

name: build colour channel ramp tables
reason: renderer: builds byte lookup tables mapping 0..max of each colour channel to the display bit depth scaled values (shared when channel widths match), used by the 16-bit surface paths; called once from 0x52C160 at display setup.

name: free display ramp tables
reason: renderer: frees the three lookup tables at globals 0x739ECC/0x739EDC/0x739EA8 (skipping aliases) and nulls them; called by 0x52C040 and 0x52CEB0 before a rebuild.

name: constant zero stub
reason: stub: returns 0; address is stored in a table, nothing calls it directly.

name: free rectangle node pool
reason: library: frees every node of the free-list at global 0x62B2A4 (linked through offset 0x10); no direct callers, address stored in a table.

name: take rectangle list node
reason: library: pops a 20-byte node from the free-list at global 0x62B2A4 (refilling it via 0x52D150 when empty) and clears its next pointer; used by the dirty-rectangle code (0x52D3C0, 0x52D480 and callers in the view and light draw code).

name: refill rectangle node pool
reason: library: allocates 20 nodes of 0x14 bytes and pushes each onto the free-list at global 0x62B2A4; called only by 0x52D120.

name: return rectangle list node
reason: library: pushes a rectangle list node back onto the free-list at global 0x62B2A4; 12 callers in the view and draw code.

name: intersect two rectangles
reason: renderer: rectangle intersection of two x y width height records; returns 4 when the overlap is empty, else 0 with the overlap written to the third argument. Used to clip blits and lines to the redraw rectangle (43 callers; cited by the user-interface ledger as the clip step).

name: subtract rectangle into pieces
reason: renderer: removes one rectangle from another and writes up to four remaining pieces (top, left, right, bottom strips); returns the piece count (0 when fully covered, 1 with the original when disjoint). Dirty-region maths used by 0x51D050 and 0x52D3C0.

name: clip rectangle against region list
reason: renderer: recursive walk of a linked list of rectangles that splits the target by 0x52D260 and queues the visible pieces on a node list (0x52D120); dirty-region/visibility computation for the window and view redraw. Only caller is itself.

name: merge rectangle into region list
reason: renderer: large recursive routine (read in outline) that merges a rectangle into a list of rectangles, trimming or splitting overlaps and joining adjacent ones, using the node pool 0x52D120/0x52D180. Dirty-rectangle accumulation for redraw, called by the view and light draw code.

name: union of two rectangles
reason: renderer: writes the bounding rectangle of two x y width height records to the third argument and returns 0; followed in the same block by a small routine at 0x52DC50 that flips negative width and height of a rectangle. Used by object animation code to accumulate redraw rectangles (19 callers).

name: line clip outcode
reason: renderer: classic outcode of a point against a float rectangle (bit 8 above, 4 below, 2 right, 1 left) for the line clipper 0x52DD00.

name: clip line to rectangle
reason: renderer: Cohen-Sutherland style clipping of an integer line segment to a rectangle through repeated outcodes; returns 4 when the segment is outside, else 0 with the clipped end points written back. Called by the line draw 0x51D6B0 and 0x566A80 (the world map waypoint lines in the ledger).

name: normalise segment to rectangle
reason: renderer: turns a line segment given by two points into an ordered rectangle (smallest corner plus absolute size); called by the line draw 0x51D6B0.

name: start timer resolution
reason: platform: calls the Windows multimedia timeBeginPeriod(1) and returns 0x10 on failure, else 0; stored in the engine init table, no direct caller (engine init per the time-loop doc TL7).

name: end timer resolution
reason: platform: calls timeEndPeriod(1); engine exit hook with no direct caller.

name: read system millisecond clock
reason: platform: stores the Windows timeGetTime value through its argument and returns 0; 37 callers stamp the module and engine clocks (rules live in callers, see time-loop TL7).

name: elapsed milliseconds since stamp
reason: platform: returns timeGetTime minus a stamp argument (32-bit wrap safe); 19 callers.

name: clamped time difference
reason: library: returns b minus a as unsigned and caps the result at 0x7FFFFFFF so a stamp in the future gives a large positive value rather than a negative one; 11 callers (map scroll, held mouse repeat, floater and speech bubble ticks). Documented in time-loop TL7.

name: make folder
reason: platform: creates a folder (full path built by 0x52F100) and returns 1 on success; the same block holds a second routine at 0x52E000 that removes a folder when it exists and is empty (0x52E1B0, 0x52F230). 13 callers.

name: clear working folder tree
reason: Recursively deletes everything inside a folder (files by 0x5300F0, sub-folders by itself and then 0x52F230), skipping the dot entries; returns 1 only if all deletions worked. It is what empties the live save folder Save\Current on reset, module load and exit (persistence PS1). Ours has no working folder (one JSON snapshot per slot in Arcanum.Session.GameSaveLibrary), so nothing carries it.

name: folder is empty test
reason: platform: lists folder\*.* through 0x52F760 and answers 1 when only the two dot entries exist; used before removing a folder.

name: folder exists test
reason: platform: asks the file layer (0x52FB80) for a path and returns 1 when it exists and has the directory attribute 0x20 bit; 17 callers, used as the Save\Current test of persistence PS1 (the rule lives in callers).

name: copy folder tree
reason: platform: recursively copies one folder (files by 0x52E840, sub-folders by itself, target created by 0x52DFE0), returns 1 on success; generic helper whose game meaning (first open of a map copies the module map folder into Save\Current) lives in the callers 0x410070 and 0x404C10.

name: write save archive pair
reason: Packs the live folder into a save slot: opens slot.tfai and slot.tfaf for writing, writes the index and data through 0x52E9C0, appends the end record (type 3) and on any failure deletes both files. Format given in persistence PS1. Ours writes one JSON file per slot (Arcanum.Session.GameSaveLibrary) so no method does this.

name: restore save archive pair
reason: Loads a save slot: makes the target folder, opens slot.tfai and slot.tfaf, then reads records (file: name length, name, size; enter folder; leave folder; end), recreating folders and copying each file body out of the data file in index order (0x52E900); stops at first error without rollback, does not bound name lengths and fails on a 0-byte file. Ours restores from a JSON snapshot (Arcanum.Session.GameSaveLibrary), not an archive.

name: copy one file
reason: platform: copies a file by opening the source for reading and the destination for writing, streaming via 0x52E8D0, and deleting the destination on failure; helper of the folder copy 0x52E260.

name: copy whole file between handles
reason: library: takes the length of an open file (0x52FB40) and copies that many bytes with 0x52E900; a zero-length file counts as success.

name: copy bytes between handles
reason: library: copies a given byte count between two open files in 32 KB chunks, returning 1 on success; used by the archive restore and file copy.

name: write archive index recursively
reason: Walks a folder (listing via 0x52F760, skipping dot entries) and for each entry writes an index record to the .tfai handle (type 0 file: name length, name, size; type 1 enter folder with the name, recursion, type 2 leave) while appending file bodies to the .tfaf handle; any write failure returns 0. Archive format of persistence PS1; ours has no archive (JSON slot in Arcanum.Session.GameSaveLibrary).

name: mount base game sources
reason: Mounts the base sources: the archive tig.dat when it exists, the game folder (current path), then the folder of the executable path (via 0x51F260); this is mount step 1 of the content search order (docs/research/content-precedence.md). Nearest ours: Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentMountPlan.Discover builds the same order from the installation but carries no address. Address stored in a table, no direct caller.

name: free watch list and unmount all
reason: startup: frees every node of the list at global 0x62B2B0 (name plus node), then jumps into the unmount-everything routine at 0x52F000; file layer shutdown with no direct caller.

name: mount content source
reason: Adds a path to the file layer search list at global 0x62B2AC: an existing entry of the same name is found and moved to the top, a folder is added as a folder source (type 2, its TIGCache cache folder is deleted at mount), a file is opened as an archive source (type 1, via 0x53BC50); returns 1 on success and logs on failure. This is the push-on-top mount rule behind the search order in docs/research/content-precedence.md; nearest ours Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentMountPlan.Discover (fixed order, no address mark). 7 callers (module and data mounts, multiplayer).

name: unmount one content source
reason: other: removes one entry by name from the search list at global 0x62B2AC, deleting a folder source cache folder or closing an archive, and frees the node; ours builds an immutable per-module stack (Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentStack) so there is no unmount. Called on module unload and by multiplayer.

name: archive identity read
reason: Finds a mounted archive source by name and copies the 16-byte module identity at offset 0x14 of its record to the caller; used by the single-player module load 0x402A50 (it stores the identity for later compatibility checks, the same identity Arcanum.Session.Launcher.PrototypeProvisioner.ModuleGuid reads from the footer) and by the network module and packet code. No method carries this address. Read once (F1).

name: ensure folder path exists
reason: platform: prefixes the first folder source for a relative name, then creates every missing folder along a backslash separated path (mkdir for each prefix); returns 0. Helper of make folder 0x52DFE0.

name: remove folder
reason: platform: removes a folder (relative names resolved against each folder source, others used as given) with the C runtime remove-directory call and returns 1 only when it works; the same block holds a second routine at 0x52F370 that adds a watched path node to the list at global 0x62B2B0 when the path has a read or write bit set.

name: resolve file to disk path
reason: platform: resolves a relative name through the search list to a real file path, extracting an archive member into the TIGCache folder of the first folder source when the file is only in an archive (so the Miles audio driver can open it by path); returns 1 and the path. Callers are the sound lock path 0x40DEE0 and the audio sample loader 0x5334D0; Godot audio replaces it.

name: list files across sources
reason: Builds a merged, sorted listing of file and folder names matching a pattern (a trailing *.* is normalised) across the search list: archive sources add their matching members, folder sources add directory entries; returns the count and an array of 0x110-byte records through its two out arguments. This is how saves, module lists and data files are found, so the content-precedence listing rule lives here. Nearest ours: Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentStack.Keys (no address mark). 25 callers.

name: free file list result
reason: library: frees the array of a file list result (0x52F760) and zeroes its count and pointer; 25 callers.

name: length of open file
reason: platform: returns the size of an open file record, using the archive member size for archive files (flag 1) or the C runtime file length for disk files (flag 2), else -1; 6 callers (message file and terrain readers among them).

name: find file in sources
reason: Looks a name up through the search list top-down: folder sources test folder\name on disk (honouring the per-archive check-loose-first flag), archive sources look the member up by name; absolute names are tested directly. On a hit optionally fills a 0x110-byte record (name, 0x82 or 0xA2 attribute mix, size, time) and returns 1. This is the lookup rule of docs/research/content-precedence.md; nearest ours Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentStack.Resolve (no address mark). 44 callers.

name: find file in one named source
reason: Same lookup as 0x52FB80 but restricted to the source whose name matches a second argument (the module folder or archive); fills the same result record and returns 1 on a hit. Only caller 0x4027C0 (the module list). Nearest ours Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentStack.Resolve, no address mark.

name: delete file
reason: platform: removes a file from the first folder source (or the given absolute path) and, when an archive below still holds the same name, sets that archive entry back to the check-loose-first state; returns 0 on success. 27 callers (save delete, map flush, mobile files).

name: rename file
reason: platform: renames a file inside every folder source in turn (or between absolute names) using the C runtime rename; returns 0 on success; only caller 0x534CB0; a second routine in the same block at 0x5302D0 opens a temporary file record.

name: create temporary file thunk
reason: thunk: calls the C runtime temporary-file creator 0x58C328 with its one argument; called by the file layer helper 0x5301F0.

name: close file layer handle
reason: library: closes a file-layer handle (releases its archive or C file part through 0x530C00, frees the wrapper 0x530BF0) and returns 0 on success or -1; a following entry point closes a raw handle by kind. Ours reads data through our own archive and file readers and the Executable emulator hooks it.

name: open file layer handle
reason: library: allocates a wrapper handle, opens the path with mode text through the search-path lookup 0x530C70 and returns the handle or null; further entry points open with an explicit buffer mode and set a stream buffer. Our readers open archives and loose files with an own design.

name: set stream buffer mode
reason: library: dispatches a stream buffer setting to the archive part (0x53C370) or the C runtime file (0x58CA34) by the handle kind flags; only caller is the open function 0x5303A0.

name: formatted write to file
reason: library: formatted print to a file-layer handle; passes the argument list to the dispatcher 0x5304C0 (archive files refuse, C files use the C runtime); a following entry point returns -1.

name: formatted write dispatch
reason: library: dispatches a formatted write by handle kind to the archive stub 0x53C3A0 or the C runtime 0x58CAD5, -1 for an unknown kind; a following entry point does the same for a one-argument call 0x53C3B0 and 0x58CB06.

name: read line from file
reason: library: reads one text line (buffer, size, handle) from an archive file (0x53C3F0) or a C file (0x58B3EB); returns null for an unknown kind. The Executable emulator hooks it, our own text readers replace it.

name: write character to file
reason: library: writes one character to a handle; archive files are read-only and answer -1 (0x53C440), C files use 0x58C568.

name: write string to file
reason: library: writes a string to a handle (archive stub 0x53C450 answers -1, C files use 0x58BFEC); a following entry point pushes a character back (0x53C460 or 0x58CB2B).

name: read bytes from file
reason: library: block read of count items of a size from a handle, by kind archive 0x53C4A0 or C file 0x58C240; returns 0 for a null buffer or zero size. The Executable emulator hooks it.

name: write bytes to file
reason: library: block write of items to a handle, archive 0x53C520 or C file 0x58C060; returns the count minus one for an unknown kind. The Executable emulator hooks it.

name: get file position
reason: library: stores the current position of a handle (via 0x530790) into the output, returns 1 if the position is unknown, else 0.

name: seek in file
reason: library: seeks a handle by offset and origin, archive 0x53C550 or C file 0x58C4DC; returns 1 for an unknown kind.

name: seek from file start
reason: library: seeks a handle to an absolute offset read through a pointer (origin 0); only caller is 0x45AED0.

name: tell position of file
reason: library: position of a handle (archive 0x53C6E0, C file 0x58C59C, -1 unknown); following entry points rewind (0x53C6F0, 0x58C1B7) and flush (0x53C710, 0x58CB99).

name: file error flag test
reason: library: tests the error flag (0x10) of a handle; following archive kind answers through 0x53C720.

name: file end reached test
reason: library: tests the end-of-file flag (0x20) of a handle (archive 0x53C730); following entry points are archive stubs 0x53C740, 0x53C760 and 0x53CB30 and a helper that writes a small buffer into a new file at a path and a directory content checker.

name: check file matches buffer
reason: library: builds the full path under the first directory entry of the search list 0x62B2AC and compares the file contents (up to 0x400 bytes) with a buffer via 0x5310C0; a following entry point tests whether a directory listing has any entries. Used by an install check.

name: allocate file wrapper
reason: library: allocates a 12-byte file wrapper (name, flags, handle) and zeroes it.

name: free file wrapper
reason: library: frees a wrapper allocated by 0x530BD0 through the memory manager 0x58A347.

name: release file wrapper parts
reason: library: closes the underlying archive file (0x53C220) or C file (0x58B395), and if the wrapper holds a temporary copy name (flag 4) deletes that copy; returns 1 on a failed close.

name: open file through search path
reason: Opens a path in the engine file layer: a relative name is looked up in the ordered search list at global 0x62B2AC (directory nodes vs archive nodes, first holding source wins, a write mode goes to the first directory node, a read of an archive file may be extracted to a temporary copy), absolute names go straight to the C runtime. Our Arcanum.Data content stack (ContentMountPlan and ContentStack.Resolve) does the same precedence by an own design with no method carrying this address.

name: convert find flags
reason: library: converts a C runtime find-data attribute byte (read-only, hidden, system, directory, archive bits) into the file layer own flag word at the pointer; callers 0x52F760, 0x52FB80, 0x52FE60.

name: sorted insert file entry
reason: library: inserts a 0x110-byte directory entry into a sorted array (binary search by name with 0x58ADB0, grow with 0x58A072, shift with 0x58B060); only caller is the directory listing builder 0x52F760.

name: compare file with buffer
reason: library: opens a file, reads up to 0x400 bytes and answers 1 when they equal a given buffer; helper of 0x530AE0.

name: find search entry for path
reason: library: walks the search-entry list at global 0x62B2B0 and returns the first entry whose name matches the path (0x53E230 then 0x53E590), or null; callers are the file layer functions 0x52F410 to 0x530C70.

name: copy file by name
reason: library: if the source exists (0x52FB80) opens it for reading and the target for writing and copies it with 0x531250; returns 1 on success. Callers are the module start 0x49CC70 and the character file functions 0x4A3780 and 0x4A39F0, whose own rules are ours elsewhere.

name: copy file contents
reason: library: copies a file in 0x8000-byte blocks from one handle to another, using sizes from 0x52FB40; returns 1 when the whole file was written.

name: delete directory tree
reason: library: recursively deletes every file and subfolder under a folder (find first and next with 0x533CD0 and 0x533D00, remove 0x58C20B, then the folder 0x595B4D); called by the cache folder cleaners 0x52ED40 and 0x52EF30 that work on the TIGCache folder. Our saves manage their own files.

name: bind movie player to sound
reason: video: asks Miles for its quick handles and gives them to the Bink library as the movie sound system; runs once at engine-library init (the last entry of the init table 0x51F130 walks), so movie audio plays through Miles.

name: empty movie hook
reason: stub: a single return instruction in the movie library table; address taken only.

name: play movie file
reason: video: plays one Bink movie (path, flags, sound track): opens it, pumps frames with 0x5317D0 and the message pump until the end or a key skip (event kind 5; a mouse button was not checked), closes it and restores the screen; returns a small error code (12, 13, 16) when the display or file fails. Called by 0x40DEE0. The movie loop is listed in the time-loop doc as TL11 other loop. Steamwoven: the viewer's per-frame tick plus MoviePlayback (frames on the host's time, any key press skips, a failed or stalled decoder ends the movie); ffmpeg is the decoder (ARC-RENDER-1170); no single counted method.

name: get open movie handle
reason: accessor: returns the open Bink movie handle global 0x62B2BC; read by the message pump 0x52BDA0.

name: decode and draw movie frame
reason: video: Steamwoven shows the frame that is due on the host's time (frames that fell behind are dropped, as Bink's wait does), starts the movie's audio with the first frame and ends the movie after its last frame or when the decoder stops; the decoder is an external ffmpeg and the surface is the viewer's movie screen (ARC-RENDER-1170); the DirectDraw surface restore does not exist.

name: reset token delimiter comma
reason: dead: sets the token delimiter global 0x5C22AC to a comma and returns 0; no caller, address taken only.

name: empty table entry
reason: stub: a single return instruction; address taken only.

name: set token delimiter
reason: accessor: stores the delimiter character in global 0x5C22AC; the rule (comma, white space skipping) lives in the token readers 0x5318F0 and 0x531A20 and in the spell record parser NamedKeyCursor.

name: read text token
reason: Skips white space, cuts the next token at the delimiter in global 0x5C22AC, copies it to the output buffer and advances the cursor past the delimiter (cursor becomes null at the end of text). Our map list reader Arcanum.Data.Maps.MapList.Read and the spell record cursor do their own token splitting with no method carrying this address.

name: read number token
reason: Same cursor walk as the text token reader 0x5318F0 but converts the token with the 64-bit atoi 0x589CB8 into a value pair (low and high) at the output; cursor becomes null at the end. Our Arcanum.Data.Maps.MapList.Read does the number reading with an own design and no method carrying this address.

name: read value after keyword
reason: Skips white space, checks that the text starts with a given keyword (prefix test 0x589D80), moves past it and white space and reads the next token with 0x5318F0; returns 1 on a match, else empty output and 0. Called by 0x560AA0 (interface band). No method of ours carries this address; nearest is the keyed value reader Arcanum.Data.Magic.NamedKeyCursor.NamedName.

name: start sound system
reason: startup: sets the Miles redistribution folder, starts the quick sound driver (22050 Hz, 16 bit, stereo), resets the 60 sound slot cursor to 6, stores the file name resolver and creates the sound cache (20 items, 1000000 bytes); dead in the census (address taken only, called through a table).

name: stop sound system
reason: startup: fades all slots out, frees the sound cache and shuts the Miles quick driver down; dead in the census (address taken only).

name: sound service pacing
reason: Called each frame from 0x51F220: when the sound system is on it keeps its own 100 ms step clock (global 0x739E84) against the frame clock 0x739F34 and, if the two differ by more than 1000 ms, resynchronises; otherwise one fade step (0x532E30) is run per 100 ms. No method of ours carries this address; our presentation player does its fades with an own design.

name: sound fade step update
reason: Per fade step over all 60 sound slots (stride 0x150): a slot fading out lowers its volume linearly over its step count (stream via set stream volume, sample via quick set volume with pan), then marks itself finished and is freed through 0x533310; a fading-in slot starts its stream at step 0 and ramps up, and a slot whose sample reached the end status is freed. Called by 0x532DE0 and 0x5330A0. Ours: the music/ambient player fades loops by an own design (audio-evidence notes the fading of loops is the player's) with no method carrying this address.

name: set sound file resolver
reason: accessor: stores the sound file name resolver callback in global 0x62B2C0; a following entry point reads the sound-system-on flag 0x6301EC.

name: start slot fade
reason: Marks a sound slot as fading (flag 4) with the absolute step count and step 0; ignored for a bad slot, sound off or an already fading slot. The fade itself runs in 0x532E30; ours fades with an own design and no method carries either address. Read once (F1).

name: start slot fade thunk
reason: thunk: passes slot and step count straight to 0x533020; caller 0x533310.

name: fade all sound slots
reason: audio engine: starts a fade of the given length on every used slot (0x533020), resets the effect slot cursor 0x6301E8 to 6 and runs a fade step (0x532E30); called by stop every sound (0x41C340).

name: allocate sound slot
reason: audio engine: picks a free slot for a sound category (0x5331A0), ORs the category channel bit from table 0x5C246C into the slot flags, loop count 1, default volume 0x7F and pan 0x40 and returns the slot through the pointer (-1 if sound is off or no slot is free).

name: pick free sound slot
reason: audio engine: finds a free slot of the 60 by category: category 0 scans round robin from the cursor 0x6301E8 over slots 6 to 59, category 1 takes slot 0 or 1, category 2 takes slots 2 to 5; clears the slot (0x5332F0), marks it used and returns its index, or logs the category and every slot name and returns -1 when full.

name: clear sound slot
reason: audio engine: zeroes the 0x150-byte slot record and sets its +0x1C field to -1.

name: stop and free sound slot
reason: audio engine: fades the slot out with zero steps, then closes the stream (AIL close stream) or unloads the sample and releases its cache entry (0x538EA0) and marks the slot unused; called by scenery loop begin 0x42DA50 path, combat music stop 0x41C5A0 and others.

name: start sound sample
reason: audio engine: copies the file name into the slot, loads the sample through the sound cache (0x538C90, quick load from memory), applies volume and pan, plays it with the slot loop count and flags the slot as a sample; frees the slot if the file cannot be loaded. Caller effect start 0x41B2E0 and 0x533480.

name: start named sound sample
reason: audio engine: resolves a sound name through the resolver in global 0x62B2C0 into a path and starts it with 0x5333A0; returns 0 when sound is off.

name: start sound stream
reason: audio engine: opens a stream file (path search 0x52F410, AIL open stream), stores its name, sets the loop count, and when a slot to replace is given marks that older slot as fading with the given step count (cross fade) and the new slot as fading in; used for music and voice streams; callers are the two thunks 0x533680 and 0x5336A0.

name: start stream thunk zero
reason: thunk: calls the stream starter 0x5334D0 with its mode argument 0; callers scheme update 0x41BAF0 and 0x41C450.

name: start stream thunk one
reason: thunk: calls the stream starter 0x5334D0 with its mode argument 1 (a following entry point reads the loop count field of a slot, 1 when sound is off); callers scheme load 0x41BE20, 0x41C370, 0x41C3D0.

name: set slot loop count
reason: accessor: stores the loop count of a slot (field +0x10); a following entry point reads the slot volume field +0x128 (0 for a bad slot). Rules live in the scheme player callers.

name: set slot volume
reason: audio engine: stores a new volume in the slot and applies it to the playing stream (AIL set stream volume) or sample (AIL quick set volume with the slot pan); skipped when unchanged.

name: change channel volume
reason: audio engine: applies a new volume to every used slot whose channel bit matches the channel (0x533760) and, for channel 0, remembers it as the default effects volume in global 0x6301F4 (0x533C30); callers are the channel change functions 0x41C8B0, 0x41C930, 0x41C980.

name: get slot channel
reason: accessor: returns which of the three channels a slot belongs to by testing its channel mask against table 0x5C246C (0 for a bad slot); a following entry point replaces the channel bit of a slot. The volume rules live in the callers.

name: get slot spatial value
reason: accessor: returns the extra per-slot value (field +0x148) set by 0x533910, or 2 when sound is off or the slot is bad; callers 0x41B3B0 and 0x41C780 (positional recalculation).

name: set slot spatial value
reason: accessor: stores the extra per-slot value in field +0x148 (set after the positional parameters are computed by 0x41B7D0); a following entry point reads the slot pan field +0x12C, 0x40 when off.

name: set slot pan
reason: audio engine: stores a pan in the slot and applies it to a playing sample (AIL quick set volume with the slot volume); not for streams; callers effect start 0x41B2E0, 0x41B3B0, 0x41C780.

name: find slot by sound id
reason: audio engine: returns 1 if any used slot carries the given identity value (field +0x124); caller is a scenery sound check at 0x41BA10.

name: sound slot finished test
reason: audio engine: answers 1 when a used slot's sample status is done (3) or its stream status is finished (4); callers scheme update 0x41BAF0 and 0x569770.

name: sound slot in use test
reason: audio engine: answers whether a slot is in use (0 for a bad slot); following entry points free the sound cache (0x538AA0) and format the debug text of the sound cache size.

name: store slot positional data
reason: audio engine: stores four positional values (listener-relative data) in the slot and raises its positional flag; caller 0x41B7D0 and 0x41C780.

name: read slot positional data
reason: audio engine: copies the four stored positional values of a used positional slot into two output pairs; a following entry point answers the positional flag; caller 0x41B3B0 (recalculate positional volume).

name: for each positional slot
reason: library: calls a callback with the slot number for each used slot that has the positional flag (field +0x134); caller 0x41B3A0.

name: set default effects volume
reason: accessor: stores the default effects volume in global 0x6301F4, used by 0x533C40; caller 0x5337D0.

name: play interface sound
reason: audio engine: when sound is on, allocates a slot (0x5330F0), starts the named file as a sample (0x533480) and sets the default effects volume (0x533760); callers are interface code at 0x4C4E60, 0x4C5070 and 0x5385C0.

name: release digital sound handle
reason: audio engine: when the window is deactivated releases the Miles digital handle, when reactivated reacquires it; caller 0x51F300 (window activation).

name: find first file
