reason: platform: wrapper of the C runtime find-first-file (0x58D2ED) that stores the search handle at +0x118 of the find record; returns 1 on success; used by the file layer and the cache cleaner.

name: find next file
reason: platform: wrapper of the C runtime find-next-file (0x58D3B7) using the handle at +0x118; returns 1 on success.

name: close file search
reason: platform: closes the find handle (0x58D47C) and zeroes the 0x11C-byte find record; returns 1 if it closed.

name: start scratch row pool
reason: renderer: dead (address taken only): for a pixel depth of 8, 16, 24 or 32 bits stores the depth and the row buffer size (0x200 or 0x400 bytes), then preloads 16 scratch blocks with 0x5342A0; for other depths shows an error text and returns 12.

name: stop scratch row pool
reason: renderer: dead (address taken only): releases the scratch block pool (0x5342E0) and clears the started flag.

name: take scratch block
reason: library: pops one block from the free list at global 0x630204 (refilling it with 0x5342A0 when empty) and returns the block data pointer; callers include light and shadow code at 0x4DE390 and 0x4DE5D0 that need a temporary row buffer.

name: return scratch block
reason: library: pushes a scratch block back on the free list at global 0x630204.

name: fill scratch row with colour
reason: renderer: fills one 512-byte or 1024-byte row buffer with a single colour value by pixel depth (8 bits unchanged, 16 bits pair, 24 and 32 bits 32-bit); caller 0x4DE200.

name: copy scratch row
reason: renderer: copies one row of the current scratch row size (global 0x630200) from a source to a destination; caller 0x505000.

name: palette tint to screen format
reason: renderer: copies a 256 entry palette, optionally scales its entries through the colour-adjust helper 0x52C370 and then remaps every entry through the screen pixel format masks (16, 24 or 32 bit modes); used for tinted art such as light tints, the icon grey and shadow maps.

name: palette buffer size accessor
reason: renderer: returns the palette buffer size global 0x630200 plus 4; only caller is the art loader 0x51B710.

name: palette buffer pool grow
reason: renderer: allocates 16 palette buffers of the size in global 0x630200 and links them into the free list at global 0x630204; called by the palette pool init 0x533D50 and 0x533DF0.

name: palette buffer pool free
reason: renderer: walks the palette buffer free list at global 0x630204 and frees every node and buffer; called by the palette module shutdown 0x533DD0.

name: hash table init
reason: library: sets up a hash table with 63 buckets (all empty) and a stored item size; generic container used by script names, multiplayer and the message system.

name: hash table free all
reason: library: frees every node of every bucket of a hash table and then its bucket array; the span also holds the neighbouring table copy and stream read helpers.

name: hash table walk with callback
reason: library: calls a callback with key, item and a user value for every entry of every bucket; stops and returns 0 as soon as the callback returns 0, else returns 1.

name: hash table insert or replace
reason: library: stores a copy of an item under an integer key (absolute value modulo the bucket count); if the key exists it only returns, else allocates a node and puts it at the head of the bucket and counts it.

name: hash table lookup copy
reason: library: finds an integer key in a hash table and copies its item to the caller buffer; returns 1 if found, else 0.

name: hash table has key
reason: library: returns 1 if an integer key is present in a hash table, else 0.

name: hash table remove key
reason: library: removes every node with a given integer key from its bucket, frees them and decrements the entry count; returns the new count.

name: hash node free
reason: library: frees a hash node payload and then the node itself.

name: hash node alloc
reason: library: allocates a 12 byte hash node plus a payload buffer of the given size and returns the node.

name: linked chain clone
reason: library: recursively copies a chain of hash nodes with their payloads and returns the new head; calls itself.

name: linked chain length
reason: library: recursively counts the nodes of a hash node chain.

name: hash chain read from file
reason: library: reads a number of items from a file stream, each as a key and a payload of the given size, building a chain of nodes; returns 1 on success and an error code on a short read.

name: file transfer slot accessor
reason: multiplayer: returns field 0xc of a network file transfer slot; the span also holds the slot table reset and the close-all routines of the 16 transfer slots at 0x630208 that log through 0x4FEB70.

name: empty function
reason: stub: only returns; called once from the engine ping 0x5287B0.

name: send file wrapper
reason: multiplayer: forwards its arguments to the network file send 0x534A70; called when sending the players folder.

name: start network file send
reason: multiplayer: when the name does not end in .RECV, finds a free transfer slot, opens the file and sends the size and name to the peer over the TIG net layer; used to send map files, players folders and other files.

name: file transfer data chunk received
reason: multiplayer: handles a data chunk of a network file transfer, writes it to the open file, adds to the received count and answers with an acknowledgement packet; logs if the slot is unknown.

name: file transfer packet handler
reason: multiplayer: dispatches the network file transfer packet types (start, chunk, end), creating the .RECV temporary name and renaming it on completion.

name: file transfer finish receive

name: sound cache entry free
reason: audio engine: Frees one 24-byte entry of the sound sample cache: lowers the live count and byte total, adds its size to the freed-bytes counter 0x636508, frees the data and name and clears the entry.

name: sound cache create

name: sound cache destroy
reason: audio engine: Frees the unused entries, the slot table and the header of the sound sample cache; called by the sound shutdown 0x532DB0.

name: sound file read to memory
reason: audio engine: Opens a named file in read mode, takes its length, allocates a buffer, reads the whole file and closes it; stores the buffer and size through two pointers and returns 1, or 0 when the file cannot be opened. Used to load a sound sample into the cache.

name: sound cache slot fill
reason: audio engine: Loads a sample file into a cache slot (0x538BC0), keeps a copy of its name, raises the live count and byte total and stores the slot's own index (offset divided by 24) in it; returns 1 or 0.

name: sound cache get or load
reason: audio engine: Looks a sample up by name (case-insensitive) in the sound cache; a hit bumps the hit counters 0x6364F8 and 0x636500 and the use count; a miss picks a slot (0x538D80), loads the file, bumps the miss counters and trims the cache to its limit; returns the slot, or the static empty slot 0x6364E8 when the load fails. name: sound cache pick slot thunk
reason: thunk: calls 0x538D90 with the same cache pointer.

name: sound cache pick slot

name: sound cache linear slot scan
reason: audio engine: Walks the cache table and returns the first empty slot, freeing the first unreferenced one it meets (0x538AE0); returns 0 when every slot is in use.

name: sound cache trim
reason: audio engine: Makes room in the sound cache: when the request exceeds the cache limit it frees all unused entries, otherwise it keeps picking slots (0x538D90) until the freed byte counter 0x636508 reaches the request or the probe count runs out. Called by the get-or-load 0x538C90 after a miss.

name: sound cache use count raise
reason: accessor: Adds one to a slot's use count (second argument, the cache pointer is ignored). Caller: 0x538C90.

name: sound cache release by index
reason: audio engine: Finds the cache slot by the index stored in a sound record and releases one use of it through 0x538EC0; called by the sound stop 0x533310.

name: sound cache slot release
reason: audio engine: Hands the slot to the C runtime helper 0x58B846 and lowers its use count by one; caller 0x538EA0.

name: unused handler does nothing
reason: stub: a bare return. Address taken (a handler table slot) but nothing calls it.

name: line draw state get

name: line draw mode set

name: line draw mode get
reason: renderer: Reads the line drawer global 0x63650C into the caller's buffer (caller 0x520660).

reason: startup: Shutdown: for every used slot of the popup menu table 0x636578 releases the slot through 0x539A40. Address taken; no direct caller.

name: debug window mouse callback
reason: debug: Window callback of the unreferenced debug text dialog 0x539130 (installed in its window descriptor): handles clicks on its buttons and scrolling of its line list, redrawing through 0x539C50. Read in outline; no caller.

name: popup menu slot free

name: popup menu open

name: popup menu item draw
reason: renderer: Draws the item rows of the popup menu window with the popup colours (highlighted row, disabled rows, separator), text through the font calls; renderer code.

name: text lines measure
reason: renderer: Measures a list of text lines with the font width call 0x535390: returns the widest line and the line height through two out pointers; used to size the popup and the debug dialog.

name: popup menu free slot find
reason: other: Returns the index of the first free slot (flag 0x1 set) of the popup table 0x636578, or -1; caller 0x5395E0.

name: popup menu slot by button
reason: other: Returns the popup table slot whose item list contains the given button handle and the item's index through an out pointer; -1 when none. Caller 0x539AA0.

name: popup identity helper
reason: other: Returns its argument unchanged (an identity accessor used by 0x539A40).

name: popup identity helper two
reason: other: Returns its argument unchanged (identity, used by 0x5390C0 and 0x539AA0).

name: popup menu window create
reason: other: Creates the popup menu's window from its item texts (size from 0x539DC0, descriptor with callback 0x53A080), draws the rows (0x539C50) and returns 1; 0 when the text measuring fails or the window cannot be created.

name: popup menu wait loop

name: popup menu mouse handler

reason: thunk: jumps to the DirectDraw import DirectDrawCreateEx (caller 0x524300).

name: direct draw clipper thunk
reason: thunk: jumps to the DirectDraw import DirectDrawCreateClipper (caller 0x524480).

name: palette quantizer init
reason: renderer: First step of the colour quantizer that builds the 256-colour palette (a neural-net palette learner): stores the sample buffer, its length and the sampling factor, clears the tables and seeds the 256 neurons on the grey diagonal. Caller 0x525ED0.

name: palette quantizer unbias
reason: renderer: Shifts every neuron's three colour values down by four bits and stores its own index in the fourth field (finishing step of the learner); caller 0x525ED0. The block also holds an unlisted writer that stores the 256 palette bytes out.

name: palette quantizer read colours
reason: renderer: Copies the learned palette (three bytes per neuron, 256 neurons) into the caller's buffer; caller 0x525ED0.

name: palette quantizer index build
reason: renderer: Sorts the neurons by their green value and builds the 256-entry start index used by the nearest-colour search; caller 0x525ED0.

name: palette nearest colour search
reason: renderer: Searches the sorted neurons outward from an index for the one with the smallest summed colour distance to a given colour and returns its palette index; caller 0x525ED0.

name: palette quantizer find winner
reason: renderer: Finds, for one input colour, the neuron with the smallest distance and the one with the best biased distance, and updates the frequency and bias tables; returns the best-biased index. Caller 0x53A8B0.

name: palette quantizer move winner
reason: renderer: Moves one neuron's three colour values towards the input colour by the learning rate (10-bit fixed point). Caller 0x53A8B0.

name: palette quantizer move neighbours
reason: renderer: Moves the neighbouring neurons on both sides of the winner towards the input colour with a falling weight (18-bit fixed point). Caller 0x53A8B0.

name: palette quantizer learn loop

name: server list init
reason: multiplayer: Clears the head and count of the list of (address text, name) pairs used by the network lobby (globals 0x638BB0, 0x638BB4); caller 0x526E60 (network options).

name: server list add
reason: multiplayer: Adds a node to the front of the network server list with copies of two strings (an IP address text and a name, empty string when null); caller 0x52AD40.

name: server list find by name
reason: multiplayer: Searches the server list for an entry whose second text equals the argument (case-insensitive compare) and returns 1 when found; caller 0x529C20.

name: data table decoded as code
reason: other: Not code: a 258-row table of 16-byte rows (pointer, index, constants) inside the code section, found by the census; no callers or readers in code, address taken. Read in outline; the table's use was not traced.

reason: Starts a directory search in an archive: copies the wildcard pattern, finds the first entry through the prefix binary search 0x53C030 and the first match 0x53C0D0; leaves the next index in the search record. Caller 0x52F760 (the file list). Our DatArchive.Entries has no wildcard walk; the prototype machine hooks 0x52F760 itself (PrototypeBuilder).

name: archive prefix binary search
reason: Cuts the search pattern at its first '*' or '?', then binary-searches the archive's sorted directory (20-byte entries) with a case-insensitive compare to find the first entry at or after that prefix; stores the index in the search record. Caller 0x53BFD0. Our DatArchive does its own name lookup without this wildcard prefix.

name: archive file search next
reason: Returns the next directory entry that matches the search pattern (0x53E590 wildcard match, same directory length via 0x53CE80), skips entries flagged 0x800, and sets the record's name, size and the directory flag (0x400 of the entry flags); 0 when the directory is exhausted. Callers 0x52F760 and 0x53BFD0. Nearest: DatArchive.Entries (no wildcard walk).

name: archive search free
reason: library: Frees the copied pattern of a search record and clears the 28-byte record; returns 1. Caller 0x52F760.

name: archive file size
reason: accessor: Returns the size field of the open archive file's entry (object +8, then +8); caller 0x52FB40 (file length).

name: archive entry find by name
reason: Binary-searches the archive's sorted directory (20 bytes per entry, comparator 0x53CEB0) for a name; stores the entry pointer and returns 1 unless the entry carries the flag 0x800 of its second word (an entry the lookup treats as absent). Six callers in the file layer. Our DatArchive.Entries lookup is the nearest (own design).

name: archive file handle close
reason: library: Closes an open archive file object (0x53CED0) and frees it; returns 0 on success and -1 on failure. Callers 0x530C00, 0x53BF40 and 0x53DEA0.

name: archive file open block
reason: Block of three pieces: a stub returning -1, an open of an archive entry by name (entry lookup 0x53C1D0 then file object 0x53C300) and a second open that allocates a record first (0x53CF50, frees it again when the entry is missing). The only listed caller 0x530330 is probably a mis-attributed edge. Nearest: DatArchive.ReadEntry (reads a whole entry; own design).

name: open archive entry stream

Ours reads whole entries with Arcanum.Data.DatArchive.ReadEntry (own design, no stream object) and no method carries this address.

name: read-only archive stubs

name: write character stub
reason: stub: Returns minus 1 at once; a write-side stream operation of the read-only archive layer, called from the file layer's table at 0x5304C0.

name: stream read one char
reason: library: Reads one character from a file stream through 0x53D040; in text mode (flag 8) a carriage return followed by a line feed is returned as the line feed and a carriage return followed by anything else is pushed back (0x53C460). Generic C-style stream helper with no game rule.

name: stream read line
reason: library: C-style line read: copies at most size minus 1 characters into the buffer through 0x53C3B0 up to and including a line feed, ends the buffer with a zero and returns it, or returns null when nothing could be read; called by the file layer's line read at 0x530540.

name: write stub minus one
reason: stub: Returns minus 1 at once; a write-side operation of the read-only archive stream layer (called from 0x530580).

name: write stub minus one two
reason: stub: Returns minus 1 at once; a write-side operation of the read-only archive stream layer (called from 0x5305C0).

name: stream push back char
reason: library: C-style push back of one character: refused for minus 1 or when a pushed character or an error is pending, otherwise stores the character, clears the end flag, sets the pushed flag and steps the position back by one.

name: stream read block
reason: library: C-style block read of size times count bytes: caps the request at the bytes left in the entry (setting the end flag), delivers a pushed-back character first, reads the rest through 0x53D0A0 and returns the number of whole items. Generic stream helper (called by 0x530640). The size times count product is not checked for overflow.

name: stream position helpers
reason: library: Two small stream helpers in one range: 0x53C520 returns its second argument minus one and 0x53C530 stores the stream's current position (0x53C6E0) into an out pointer and returns 1; called from the file layer's position routine at 0x5306A0.

name: stream seek
reason: library: C-style seek (start, current, end) on an archive entry stream: refuses an errored stream and, in text mode, any move other than zero; a plain entry uses SetFilePointer on the entry's offset, a compressed entry seeking backward restarts the inflate state at the entry start and then skips forward by reading into a scratch buffer 0x638BBC in 0x4000-byte steps; an out-of-range target sets the error flag. The routine at 0x53C6C0 is the same seek with the start origin. Generic stream code; read in outline.

name: stream tell
reason: accessor: Returns the stream's current position (field 0x10); the rule lives in callers 0x530790 and 0x53C520.

name: stream rewind
reason: library: C-style rewind: clears the end and error flags (0x53C710) and seeks to position 0 from the start (0x53C550); called from the file layer at 0x530790.

name: stream clear flags
reason: accessor: Clears the end and error flags of a stream (mask minus 7 keeps the text and pushed-character bits); called by 0x530790 and the rewind 0x53C6F0.

name: stream end flag
reason: accessor: Returns the stream's end-of-file bit (flag 2); the rule lives in the caller 0x530820.

name: stream error flag
reason: accessor: Returns the stream's error bit (flag 4); the rule lives in the caller 0x530850.

name: set log hooks
reason: accessor: Stores its two arguments in globals 0x63CBC4 (error hook) and 0x63CBBC (message hook) used by the archive tool's log functions 0x53E1F0 and 0x53E1B0; called from the file layer's table at 0x530850.

name: pack archive tool
reason: editor: The archive packer of the engine's own dat tool: parses the arguments (0x53D180), expands the file list and sorts it (0x53D2E0), writes the entries (0x53D930) and the index and footer (0x53E030), logging every step and freeing the lists on each failure path; reached only through the file layer's table at 0x5308A0, never in play. Read in outline.

name: unpack archive tool
reason: editor: The extract and list command of the engine's dat tool: parses the arguments (0x53D180), opens the archive (0x53BC50), validates every wildcard (0x53E230), then for each entry matching a wildcard (default all) logs it and, unless the list-only flag is set, extracts it with 0x53DEA0; reached only through the file layer's table at 0x5308C0.

name: archive ignore list reader
reason: On archive open (called from 0x53BC50) reads the sidecar text file named archive path plus .ignore: every line that is a well-formed wildcard (0x53E230) marks every archive entry whose name matches it (0x53E590) and has the same number of path separators (0x53CE80) with the ignored bit 0x800, so the archive lookup treats it as absent. Ours does not implement it: Arcanum.Data.Content.ContentStack refuses an archive that has such a sidecar file (IgnoreListUnsupported).

name: count path separators
reason: library: Counts the backslashes in a string; used by the ignore-list reader 0x53CCE0 and by the archive tool.

name: compare strings for sort
reason: library: Sort comparator over two pointers to strings: compares the two strings with the C case-insensitive compare 0x58ADB0; address taken, no direct caller.

name: close archive entry stream
reason: library: Closes an entry stream: unlinks it from its archive's list of open streams (list head field 0xC, next field 0x20), closes the file handle, frees the inflate state of a compressed entry (0x4F8450 and free) and zeroes the 36-byte stream; returns 1, or 0 when the stream is not in the list; called by 0x53C220 and 0x53C250.

name: open entry stream on archive
reason: Opens the archive file with CreateFileA (read, random access), seeks to the entry's stored offset, marks text mode for a t in the mode text and, for a compressed entry (flag 2), allocates a 0x4038-byte buffer and starts the inflate state (version text 1.1.2 at 0x5B9BA0); links the stream into the archive's open list. A write mode returns 0. The container read is ours through Arcanum.Data.DatArchive.ReadEntry (own design); no method carries this address.

name: stream get byte
reason: library: C-style get-one-byte on an entry stream: returns a pushed-back byte first, sets the end flag at the entry's size, else reads one byte through 0x53D0A0 and returns it or minus 1; called by 0x53C3B0.

name: read and inflate entry bytes
reason: Reads the requested number of bytes from an entry stream: a plain entry (flag 1) goes straight to ReadFile; a compressed entry (flag 2) refills a 0x4000-byte buffer from the file and inflates (0x4F85D0) until the request is filled, updating the stream position and the error flag. Ours inflates a whole entry in Arcanum.Data.DatArchive.ReadEntry (own design) and no method carries this address.

name: archive tool argument parser
reason: editor: Parses the dat tool's command line: switch letters (via a jump table on the character after a minus or slash) set flags for list-only, recursive and so on and a digit sets the compression level global 0x5C2870; the first non-switch argument becomes the archive name and the rest are copied into a file-name list. Never run in play.

name: archive tool build file list
reason: editor: Builds the dat tool's file list: an argument starting with @ is read as a list file (0x53D530), other arguments are expanded by 0x53D660; the list is sorted with the comparator 0x53D500 (quicksort 0x58A548), duplicates with the same name are merged when their kinds agree and logged as ambiguous otherwise; returns 0 when any duplicate was ambiguous.

name: strip drive from path
reason: library: Returns the part of a path after a drive colon and, when it starts with a double backslash, after the next backslash, then skips one leading backslash; helper of the dat tool's sort and naming.

name: compare entry names
reason: library: Sort comparator over two list entries: compares their names after the drive part is stripped (0x53D4C0) with the case-insensitive compare 0x58ADB0; address taken for the quicksort in 0x53D2E0, no direct caller.

name: archive tool read list file
reason: editor: Reads a list file of the dat tool line by line (256-byte lines), skipping blank lines and lines starting with a double slash, trimming the line feed, and adds each name through 0x53D660; logs when the file cannot be opened.

name: archive tool expand file name
reason: editor: Expands one file name or wildcard of the dat tool's list through the directory walk (0x533CD0, 0x533D00, 0x533D20): adds plain files, and in recursive mode adds each directory as an entry with flag 0x400 and recurses; the entry list grows in 20-byte records.

name: archive tool write entries
reason: editor: Writes every listed entry into the new archive: logs Adding file, stores directories as flag 0x400, files ending .mp3 or .bik are stored plain (flag 1), other files are compressed (0x53DB60, flag 2) or stored plain when that fails, prints the ratio, then writes the index and footer (0x53E030) and patches the 4-byte size; returns 1 on success.

name: archive tool compress file
reason: editor: Compresses one source file into the archive being written with the deflate library (version text 1.1.2) in 0x1000-byte blocks at the tool's level, restoring both file positions and returning 0 on any failure; part of the dat tool.

name: archive tool copy file plain
reason: editor: Copies one source file byte by byte into the archive being written without compression (character read and write of the C runtime), restoring both file positions on failure; the same range also holds the tool's path stack push 0x53DE30 and pop 0x53DE70 (five slots, global 0x63CBDC).

name: archive tool extract entry
reason: editor: Extracts one archive entry to disk: builds the output path (optionally under the base folder on the tool's path stack), creates each missing folder, and for a file entry opens the entry stream (0x53C300) and copies it byte by byte to the output file; used by the unpack tool 0x53CB30.

name: archive tool write index
reason: editor: Writes the new archive's index: entry count, then for every entry its name length, name and 20-byte record, followed by the footer: with a fresh GUID (CoCreateGuid) the 16 GUID bytes and the marker DAT1 (0x44415431), or without one the marker DAT plus space (0x44415420), then the two size words; returns 1 on success.

name: log message through hook
reason: callback slot: Formats its arguments into a 1 KB buffer (vsprintf 0x58BC08) and passes the text to the message hook in global 0x63CBBC if one is set; used for the archive tool's progress lines.

name: log error through hook
reason: callback slot: Formats its arguments into a 1 KB buffer (0x58BC08) and passes the text to the error hook in global 0x63CBC4 if one is set; used for the archive tool's and file layer's error lines.

name: check wildcard pattern
reason: library: Checks that a wildcard pattern is well formed (a closing bracket for every set, a range end, no dangling escape character) and returns 1 or 0; the range 0x53E2D0 holds a second routine that matches a string against a pattern after this check. Generic string helper; used by the archive ignore list and the dat tool.

name: wildcard match
reason: library: Recursive case-insensitive wildcard matcher: a star matches any run, a question mark one character, brackets give sets and ranges with an exclamation mark for not, and the backtick escapes the next character; returns 1 on a full match. Generic string helper; read in outline.

name: wildcard match wrapper
reason: library: Null-checking wrapper of the wildcard matcher 0x53E320 (pattern first, text second; a null pattern or text gives 0); the range also holds ten thunks to the Bink video library imports (open, close, next frame, do frame, copy to buffer, sound system and track) at 0x53E5B0 to 0x53E5E6.

name: direct input create thunk
reason: thunk: Jumps to the imported DirectInputCreateA of DINPUT; called from the input start code at 0x537A10.

name: interface library init
reason: startup: Initialises the interface library: calls the init hook of each of the 32 module rows of table 0x5C2AE0 (36 bytes a row) in order, on a failure logs the row and calls the exit hooks of the rows before it in reverse and returns 0; on success registers the library's save and load hooks 0x53E7C0 and 0x53E950 with the game library (setters 0x4038E0 and 0x4038F0) and sets the ready flag 0x63CBE4. Called once from main (0x401000).

name: interface library exit
reason: startup: Logs and calls the exit hook of each interface module row in reverse order, then clears the ready flag 0x63CBE4; called by main and the exit code at 0x549580.

name: interface library reset
reason: startup: Calls the reset hook of each of the 32 interface module rows in order; the rules are in the individual hooks. Called by the quit to the main menu path (0x541710) and by the death reset (0x57D410).

name: interface library resize fan-out
reason: other: Calls the resize hook (row field 0x20) of each of the 32 interface module rows with the given argument; called by the hide toggle at 0x5578E0.

name: interface library module load
reason: startup: Unloads first (0x53E790), then calls the module-load hook of each interface row in order; on the first failure runs the unload hooks of the rows already loaded in reverse and returns 0; otherwise sets the loaded flag 0x63CBE8 and returns 1. Called from main, the quit to the main menu (0x549310) and 0x589430.

name: interface library module unload
reason: startup: When the loaded flag 0x63CBE8 is set, calls the module-unload hook of each interface row in reverse order and clears the flag.

name: interface modules save to data2
reason: The interface library's save hook: needs the Save Current folder, creates Save Current data2.sav, writes the version 25, then for each interface row with a save hook calls it with the open file and writes the 4-byte sentinel 0xBEEFCAFE after its blob, logging offsets; any failure logs, closes and deletes the file. The project saves with its own schema (the session snapshot codec) and no method carries this address.

name: interface modules load from data2
reason: The interface library's load hook: opens Save Current data2.sav, reads the 4-byte version (read and logged, not compared), then for each interface row with a load hook calls it with a version and file record and requires the 0xBEEFCAFE sentinel after the blob, stopping with a log line on a mismatch or short read. The project restores with its own schema and no method carries this address.

name: take menu restart flag
reason: accessor: Returns the main menu restart flag 0x63CBE0 and clears it when set; the rule (open the menu again) is in the main loop caller 0x401560.

name: set menu restart flag
reason: accessor: Sets the main menu restart flag 0x63CBE0; called by the quit to the main menu at 0x549310 when no menu was open.

name: clear menu restart flag
reason: accessor: Clears the main menu restart flag 0x63CBE0; called by the menu close and game start 0x5412E0.

name: logbook module init
reason: The logbook module's init: loads mes logbk_ui.mes (handle 0x648984) and mes quotes.mes (0x6429CC), builds the eight 44-byte text styles (font art 229 and 27, colours black, blue, green and red from the display's colour shifts, plain or struck), fills the 100 spread starts with minus 1 and sets the module's tab and page state. Our logbook window takes the colours only in the viewer's AreaLogbookArt (not a mapped method of the core assemblies).

name: logbook module exit
reason: startup: Frees the two logbook message files (0x4D4630) and the eight text styles (0x535330) and clears the module's ready flag 0x64B868; no rule.

name: logbook reset
reason: The logbook module's reset: destroys the open logbook window if any (0x53F090), refills the 100 spread starts with minus 1 (first start 0), and sets the tab and page back to the first (rumors tab, first spread) as a game reset does. Kept only in the viewer's logbook window, not by a mapped method.

name: logbook toggle open
reason: Toggle for the logbook window: if open it closes it (0x53F090); else for a live PC handle (checked through 0x45D8D0 and two interface-mode gates 0x551A80 with 0 and 7) it stores the PC handle in global 0x63FAD8 and builds the window (0x53F0E0). Callers: in-game event handler 0x54B5D0 and 0x54C8E0. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbook.Refusal and the Arcanum.World.InterfaceModes rules are the nearest).

name: logbook close
reason: Closes the logbook when open and the interface mode check 0x551A80(0) passes: runs the destroy 0x53F2F0 and clears the stored PC handle 0x63FAD8. Called by the toggle, window callback, interface reset 0x541710 and others. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies.

name: logbook open flag
reason: accessor: returns the logbook-open flag global 0x64B86C; the rule lives in the caller 0x556A90.

name: logbook window create
reason: Builds the logbook: registers window callback 0x53F350 with the 0x5C33F0 window slot, plays the page-turn sound, loads the 800 by 400 window art, tab and page rectangles from table 0x5C33F8, sets the view-window lens of the PC portrait (0x550DA0), draws the first tab (0x53F490) and marks the window open. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbookArtLayout).

name: logbook window destroy
reason: Destroys the logbook window: switches the lens mode off (0x550DA0 with 0), frees the window slot, plays the close sound 0xBC1 and clears the open flag; restores a saved hover state. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies.

name: logbook window callback
reason: Window callback of the logbook: a left release inside the PC lens closes the window (0x53F090); a release on a tab button switches the tab (0x53F5F0); the previous and next page buttons turn the page (0x53F6A0, 0x53F640); hover over a tab prints its title message through 0x550750, leaving clears it (0x550720). Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbookArtView).

name: logbook tab select and panel draw
reason: Draws the logbook panel (book art, page art) for the requested tab, keeps the current tab in 0x64897C, finds the tab slot of the tab-art and plays the tab sound 0xBC3, then runs the tab switch 0x53F5F0 with the keep flag. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies.

name: logbook tab switch
reason: Switches the logbook tab: unless the keep flag is set it clears the 100 page-start entries and returns to page 1, then rebuilds the entry list (0x53FBB0), redraws the spread (0x53F6E0) and plays the page sound 0xBC2. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbookArtView).

name: logbook next page
reason: Turns to the next spread when entries remain and fewer than 100 spreads exist: adds 2 to the page, records the next spread start, redraws (0x53F6E0) and plays the page sound. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbookArtView turn).

name: logbook previous page
reason: Turns back one spread when the current spread starts after entry 0: subtracts 2 from the page, redraws and plays the page sound. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies.

name: logbook spread redraw
reason: Redraws the logbook spread: hides the page buttons, draws the page art, lays out both columns (0x53F8F0), shows the previous and next buttons when entries exist before or after, draws the tab title (message by tab) in both halves as -title- and the two page numbers as -n-. Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbookArt).

name: logbook spread layout
reason: Lays out entries over the two text columns for one spread, starting at a given entry and moving to the next column when the current one is full (the first entry of the second column carries over); returns the last entry placed. Uses the entry fill 0x53F9E0 for each entry's height. The nearest method is the viewer AreaLogbookArtLayout.Spread, which is not a counted assembly.

name: logbook entry fill
reason: Dispatcher over the seven tabs through the jump table at 0x53FAAC: builds one entry's text (rumor 0x540310, quest 0x540470, reputation 0x540510, injuries and blessings 0x540550, kill lines 0x5405C0, background 0x540760, key 0x5407B0) into a 2000-byte buffer and draws or measures it through 0x53FAD0 with the style colour (list 0x648988). Only the terrain viewer (tools/terrain-viewer) carries it, which is not one of the counted assemblies (AreaLogbook.Build).

name: logbook entry text draw
reason: Measures an entry's text in the column rectangle with the font of the entry and, when the text is too tall and the truncation flag is set, drops trailing characters until it fits (logs a message once); draws it unless measure-only; returns the height used or -1 for an empty text. Drives how many entries fit on a spread. The nearest is viewer AreaLogbookArtLayout.SplitPieces, outside the counted assemblies.

name: logbook list builder
reason: Builds the entry list of the active tab into the shared arrays 0x63FAE4 (ids), 0x6429D8 (timestamps) and 0x648988 (style colours): rumors through 0x4C5A40, quests through 0x4C52E0 (state colours), reputation through 0x4C1C30, blessings and curses merged by time (0x4C4200, 0x4C3D50, clock compare 0x45A970), kills and injuries (nine fixed lines then injuries, with flags 0x80/0x400/0x200/0x100 selecting highlight lines and one effect count 0x4EA4A0), background (text broken into column-wide lines) and keys (0x463110). Read in outline. Our Arcanum.Data.LogbookTexts and Arcanum.Session getters supply the data, but no method is the list builder; the viewer AreaLogbook.Build does it.

name: logbook rumor entry
reason: Rumor entry text: with the low-intelligence flag 0x648980 set it fetches the rumor message from the low file, else builds the date line (0x5403C0), a newline and the rumor text via 0x4C5920. The viewer AreaLogbook.Build covers it; not a counted assembly.

name: logbook entry date line
reason: Formats a logbook timestamp (slot of 0x6429D8) as month name from message 6 plus month, day, year, hour on a 12-hour clock with am or pm, minute with two digits, followed by four spaces; hour 12 shows as pm and hour 0 as 12 am. The nearest is viewer AreaLogbook.Date, outside the counted assemblies.

name: logbook quest entry
reason: Quest entry text: date line, then the quest state label (message state+19) joined to the quest description text from 0x4C5250 for the quest id. Covered by viewer AreaLogbook.Build only.

name: logbook reputation entry
reason: Reputation entry text: date line, newline, then the reputation name via 0x4C1BD0. Covered by viewer AreaLogbook.Build only.

name: logbook blessing or curse entry
reason: Entry of the blessings and curses tab: date line and newline, then the blessing name (0x4C4150) when the entry's style is the blessing colour 0x64893C, else the curse name (0x4C3CA0). Covered by viewer AreaLogbook.Build only.

name: logbook kill and injury line
reason: Formats one of the kills and injuries lines: lines 0-6 are 'label: value' for the kill statistics (value from the kill log slots 0x648940 and the object name 0x4D4210, '-----' when none), line 7 is blank, line 8 the injuries heading, higher lines an injury kind text plus the object description. Read for the nine fixed lines. The nearest method is viewer AreaLogbook (kills tab builder) and Arcanum.Session.GameSessionKillLog holds the data, but neither carries the address.

name: logbook background entry
reason: Background tab entry: copies the slice of the background description body (0x4C2530) between the recorded line starts into the output. Covered by viewer AreaLogbook.Build only.

name: logbook key entry
reason: Key tab entry: copies the key's name text (0x4D4260) for the key id into the output. Covered by viewer AreaLogbook.Build only; Arcanum.Data.LogbookTexts.KeyName gives the name.

name: startup rumor text check
reason: debug: called once from the start-up routine 0x401000; walks all 3000 rumor ids, builds the date line plus text for the normal and the low-intelligence file, measures it (0x53FAD0) and writes a log line (0x4FEB70) for an entry that does not fit. A developer content check with no game rule. Docs list it as part of the logbook window.

name: main menu interface init
reason: Interface module init of the main menu (read in outline): loads mes\mainmenu.mes, rules\mainmenu.mes and mes\multiplayer.mes, reads the config keys for online account, version display and the selected character id (0x438C80), creates the menu art and button images with their colour keys (0x504330, 0x5352E0 loops) and starts the menu with type 0 (0x541180) after setting the save-preview sizes (0x4044A0). Also holds the online-account and multiplayer text hooks. The viewer TerrainViewerAreaMainMenu carries the menu; no counted method carries the address.

name: main menu interface shutdown
reason: startup: module shutdown of the main menu: closes the menu (0x5412E0 with 1), stores the selected character id in the config, frees the button and background images and the three menu message files, and clears the menu flag. No game rule; reached only through the exit list (address taken).

name: menu start by type
reason: Opens the menu with a start type: raises the pause counter (not for type 4 or when game-running flag 0x62AC6C bit 0 is set), clears the cursor, closes the inventory window and other overlays (0x573440, 0x570130), then picks the first window by type (0 or no art yet: window 0; 2: window 3 in-play menu; 3: window 4; 4: window 6 options; 5: window 0x1A) and opens it (0x541740) with the hover cleared. Refuses when the menu is already up (flag 0x64C384). Callers: main loop 0x401560, menu init 0x540930, 0x57D410. The viewer TerrainViewerAreaMainMenu opens the menu; no counted method carries 0x541180.

name: close menu thunk
reason: thunk: calls the menu close and game start 0x5412E0 with argument 0.

name: menu close and game start
reason: only the new character's best weapon and body armour into empty slots (the best-items flag 0x64C424); the menu close, the start-map teleport of a new game and the multiplayer paths are the viewer's or not built

name: main menu step
reason: One step of the menu from the main loop: pumps interface events, makes sure the current window is at least window 2 (opens the first window when the index is 0 or 1), runs the event queue until the menu flag clears; a type-3 event (quit request) asks the quit question (0x541690) and returns 0 when confirmed, a type-8 event runs 0x4045A0, ping time events (0x45B370). Callers: start-up 0x401000, main loop 0x401560. The viewer main menu loop does the same with own design.

name: menu is up flag
reason: accessor: returns the menu-open flag global 0x64C384 that hotkey and window code test before acting.

name: quit question thunk
reason: thunk: calls the quit question 0x5416A0 with message 5100 (0x13EC) of mes\MainMenu.mes.

name: quit question box
reason: Builds the yes/no dialog request for a MainMenu.mes message (letters y and n, callback 0x4045A0) and runs the dialog box 0x51EA60; returns its answer. Used for the quit and the quit-to-menu confirmations. The viewer AreaDialogBox carries the window; no counted method has the address.

name: interface and game reset
reason: Closes every game window (inventory 0x573440, 0x55A150, 0x57B450, 0x560F40, logbook 0x53F090, 0x56FC40, 0x56D2D0), resets the game state (0x402380) and then the interface (0x53E6E0). Called by quit to menu, menu load and new game. The session reset is done by the Arcanum.Session owner with own design; no method carries the address.

name: menu window open
reason: Opens the menu window with the current index: clears the hover id, calls the descriptor's open callback (slot +4 of the entry in table 0x5C3A40) or the default window build 0x546330, and pushes the window index on the back stack (0x541810) unless a back move is under way (0x64C38C). The viewer AreaMainMenu holds the table; not counted.

name: menu window close and back
reason: Closes the current menu window through the descriptor's close slot (+8) and the window destroy 0x546DD0; when the back flag is set it pops the back stack (0x5417E0) and reopens that window (0x541740). The viewer AreaMainMenu carries it; not counted.

name: menu back stack pop
reason: Pops the menu's back stack (global depth 0x64C390, entries at 0x64C004): the new top is the window to return to, 0 when only one entry remains. Part of the back behaviour of Cancel and Escape; viewer AreaMainMenu carries it.

name: menu back stack push
reason: Pushes a window index on the menu's back stack (array 0x64C004, depth 0x64C390). Viewer AreaMainMenu carries it; no counted method.

name: menu text escape filter
reason: Copies a UI text replacing the two-character escape backslash-t with five spaces. Used by the menu text draw 0x5418A0 (the census block also holds a short wrapper at 0x541880 that calls 0x5418A0 with the default font slot 0x64C210 and flags 0). Viewer AreaPremadeBrowserArt holds the rule; not counted.

name: menu text wrap and draw
reason: Menu text draw into a rectangle: splits at the two-character escape for a new line, replaces tab escapes (0x541830), measures with the current font (0x535390) and, depending on the flags (1: shrink by removing trailing characters until it fits, 2: break at spaces), shortens or wraps, then draws each piece (0x535570) and advances by its height; logs when drawing fails. Callers: the save list and character-creation text writers. Viewer code (AreaNewCharacterArt) mirrors it; not a counted assembly.

name: menu window 2 open
reason: Open callback of menu window 2 (addr taken in table 0x5C3A40): sets the current window to 2, builds it (0x546330), counts one open in 0x64C43C and goes on to the version overlay 0x541AC0. The viewer AreaMainMenu carries the window; not counted.

name: version text overlay
reason: debug: when config 'show version' is set it draws the game version string in a corner rectangle of the main menu (0x51E190 on the font of 0x5C3624, logging a failed draw). Developer overlay, off by default.

name: in-play menu button callback
reason: Event callback of window 3: a press on the Quit button asks the quit question (0x5416A0); on yes it closes the button (0x538840) and goes to the main menu (0x549310), first saving the player character (0x4A38B0 with 0x549310 as callback) when game-running flag 0x62AC6C bit 0 is set; a press on Continue goes back (0x5417A0 with 1) or closes the menu (0x5412D0). Viewer TerrainViewerAreaMainMenu carries the menu; not counted.

name: in-play menu button callback two
reason: Same shape as 0x541B50 for window 4 (different button offsets +0x3C quit and +0x6C continue): quit asks the question and goes to the main menu with the character save when needed; continue goes back or closes the menu. Viewer menu only.

name: options window open
reason: Open callback of window 6 (options): closes the game windows (0x541D40), sets window 6, builds it (0x546340), builds the first options page (0x589280), shows the version overlay and sets the view window of the PC (0x550DA0 pair); on entry it keeps the pause. The viewer options window carries it; not counted.

name: close game windows

reason: renderer: callback of the kind 18 MainMenu timed event (the time loop table entry 18, 0x45AD80 stub before it is installed): advances the animated menu art slot to its next frame (looping to frame 0 at the end), redraws the art in its rectangle (0x51DA80) and reschedules itself with the slot's delay; returns 1 at once for an empty slot.

name: menu action dispatcher
reason: Menu window action dispatcher by code: 0 and 1 scroll the list top down or up one row (0x548FF0), 2 runs the window's action (+0x58) and, when it passes and the menu is up, closes the window and opens the next window number (window 15 closes the menu and starts the game instead), 3 goes back (window 6 asks 0x589430 first), 4 and 5 move the list selection up or down with the selection flags, then redraws. Callers 0x542460, 0x543890, 0x545C70, 0x546EE0. Nearest counted: Arcanum.World.AreaMenuWindow (window and back model); the dispatcher is the viewer's AreaMainMenu.

name: character picker row click
reason: multiplayer: click on a row of the character picker list: selected index is the scroll top 0x64C378 plus the pointer's y divided by 20; with an index past the list clears the selection and the info, otherwise copies that character's object record (0x407EF0) into 0x64C248, then redraws (0x548BE0).

name: character picker stat panel
reason: multiplayer: draws the stat and info panel of the highlighted saved character in the multiplayer lobby windows (read in outline, 2240 bytes): reads its 'selected_char_id' record, draws the portrait (0x4CEB80) and the labelled stats (0x4B0490 values), displayed damage and armour ratings (0x464630, 0x464700); called by 0x548BE0 and 0x583540.

name: character picker background draw
reason: multiplayer: draws the full-screen background art 753 of the multiplayer character picker window and then its buttons (0x549960) through the window's current update rectangle; called by 0x548BE0.

name: character picker redraw
reason: multiplayer: redraw of the multiplayer character picker window: draws the background (0x548B60), the list rows of the saved player characters with a highlight (rows 20 high, 16 visible), and the selected character's panel (0x5482A0); callers 0x546180, 0x546EE0 and 0x548210.

name: menu list scroll thumb draw
reason: renderer: Draws the scroll thumb of a main menu list window: looks up an art frame (0x504330, 0x5031C0) and blits it at an x offset from the current position (+0x84) and maximum (+0x88) of the current window descriptor. Called from the position setter 0x548FF0 and two menu handlers.

name: menu list position set
reason: other: Sets the current main menu window's list position clamped to 0..maximum (+0x88), redraws the thumb (0x548F10) and calls the window's event callback (+0x54) with 0; the rule is a plain clamp used by the previous/next buttons (0x5480C0). Ours pages lists with its own widget.

name: internet game login screen handler
reason: multiplayer: Window handler of the internet (WON) login screen: case 2 stores the password in the config under won_password, case 1 checks the matchmaker config and shows error boxes (messages 0x804) before going on, case 0 closes and restores the back stack. Only the network game uses it.

name: multiplayer window button handler
reason: multiplayer: Window callback taking 0 or 1 that sits between the multiplayer screens: 0 refreshes the maintain bar slots (0x57C4B0) and closes the window into the multiplayer window set up by 0x583200; 1 closes it and opens the character window (0x5446F0). Reached only through a descriptor table; read in outline, its role is inferred from the callees (matchmaker and Multiplayer.mes ones).

name: quit to the main menu
reason: Quit-to-main-menu step: when an id is given it is applied through 0x5387E0, with the menu up the current window closes and the menu index is set to 2, else the flag 0x53EAF0 is set; then the current module is unloaded and the default module loaded again (0x402A50), the interface reset (0x53E730, 0x541710); a failed load logs and exits. Steamwoven loads its start scene with a fresh session instead, so no method carries it.

name: name field text edit begin
reason: Starts typing in the new-character name field (and the save window's field): copies the old text to the keep buffer 0x64C0F0 when the field is not empty, fills the text edit descriptor 0x5C4008 (flags, buffer), starts the edit (0x566E50), calls the window callback and bumps the edit counter (0x549A40). Ours keeps the old text as the before argument of CharacterCreationRules.EndTyping but has no begin method.

name: name field end
reason: the empty field taking back its old text; the window's cursor and redraw calls are the viewer's

name: name field done
reason: the empty field taking the default name (message 500); the save window's branch (window 8) is not this window's

name: text edit owner getter
reason: accessor: Returns the edit descriptor's buffer word (0x5C400C) while a text edit is active (0x64C428 nonzero), else 0; the rule lives in the key handlers that ask it.

name: text edit change notify
reason: other: The text edit's change call: calls the current menu window's event callback (+0x54) with its edit record and, in window 8 (save window), refreshes the list with 0x5806F0 from globals 0x64C220 and 0x64C224. Glue between the shared text edit and the window.

name: engine shutdown and exit
reason: startup: Logs a message, runs the shutdown calls of the engine (0x53E790, 0x402C60, 0x53E6A0, 0x4024D0, 0x51F1D0, 0x4FE7A0) and exits the process; the census block ends with a small helper that re-calls the current menu window's callback with 0. Called from the menu key handler and the multiplayer screen.

name: unread menu value setter
reason: accessor: Stores its argument in global 0x64C448 and tells the current menu window through its callback (+0x54); nothing reads the global in the executable, so it only refreshes. Reached from the function table built around 0x57C88B.

name: unread menu value setter two
reason: accessor: Twin of 0x5495F0: stores its argument in global 0x64C44C (nothing reads it) and notifies the current menu window's callback.

name: internet account name config read
reason: multiplayer: Reads the config string won_account and hands it to the account setter 0x584AA0 of the internet screens; called from the main menu init 0x540930.

name: internet password config read
reason: multiplayer: Reads the config string won_password and hands it to the password setter 0x584AC0 of the internet screens; called from the main menu init 0x540930.

name: selected character config read
reason: Reads the config entry selected_char_id (a 24-byte object id) into global 0x64C248, the pre-made character the browser last had selected; called from the main menu init 0x540930. No method of ours reads that key.

name: menu window descriptor getter
reason: accessor: Returns the descriptor pointer of main menu window n from the window table 0x5C3A40.

name: current menu window index getter
reason: accessor: Returns the current main menu window index (global 0x64C414); 13 callers.

name: quick save start note
reason: F7 branch helper: posts main-menu message 5060 (Saving...) through the note poster 0x5496F0. Only the viewer scene (TerrainViewerAreaQuickSave) says it; no Arcanum.* method carries it.

name: message note post by number
reason: Reads message n from the main menu file (handle 0x5C3FB4, 0x4D45E0 then 0x4D43A0), posts it to the message window as a type 6 note (0x550750) and presents (0x51CF40); the five quick save and load note helpers call it. No method of ours.

name: quick save done note
reason: F7 branch helper: posts message 5062 (Save completed.) after the save, whatever its result.

name: quick save refused in turn-based note
reason: F7 branch helper: posts message 5065 for the turn-based refusal; the ledger says it is not modelled.

name: quick load start note
reason: F8 branch helper: posts message 5061 (Loading...) before the quick load reads.

name: quick load done note
reason: F8 branch helper: posts message 5063 (Load completed.) after the quick load, whatever the outcome.

name: text reverse and rot13 scramble
reason: multiplayer: Reverses a string into the buffer and then rotates each letter by 13; the wrapper 0x549800 calls it. Used to scramble the internet screens' stored password, so it serves the network game only.

name: menu window handle getter
reason: accessor: Returns global 0x5C3624, the main menu's TIG window handle; used by drawing and window calls.

name: current menu window index setter
reason: accessor: Stores its argument in the current menu window index 0x64C414.

name: main menu message file getter
reason: accessor: Returns the message file handle 0x5C3FB4 of mes MainMenu; 22 callers.

name: menu colour table build
reason: renderer: Builds a table of 4 by 10 TIG colours (0x64C170 to 0x64C210) from palette bytes of four art sets via 0x504330 and 0x5352E0; called from the main menu init 0x540930.

name: menu colour table free
reason: renderer: Frees the 40 colours built by 0x549850 (calls 0x535330 on each); called from the main menu shutdown 0x541050.

name: menu colour lookup
reason: accessor: Returns colour (row times 10 plus column) of the table 0x64C170; 25 callers (menu and HUD text drawing).

name: redraw all window button labels
reason: renderer: Redraws every button label of the current menu window in state 0 by calling 0x547E00 for each button index below the count (+0x28).

name: menu back stack restore
reason: multiplayer: Copies n saved dwords into the menu back stack 0x64C008 and sets its count to n plus 1; every caller is a multiplayer screen.

name: modal message box show
reason: other: Shows a TIG modal message box (0x51EA60) for the given text with a fixed size and returns true when the result is 0 (confirmed); callers are the load and multiplayer windows. Box drawing is the engine's.

name: matchmaker box callback
reason: multiplayer: Message box callback that asks the matchmaker state (0x4A4EE0): 2 returns 0, else stores whether the state is 1 and returns 1. Network game only.

name: text edit counter up
reason: accessor: Increments the text edit owner count 0x64C468 (callers 0x5493C0 and 0x585970); the key handlers test it.

name: text edit counter down
reason: accessor: Decrements the text edit owner count 0x64C468 (callers 0x549450 name field end and 0x585A20).

name: text edit counter getter
reason: accessor: Returns the text edit owner count 0x64C468; the menu key handler 0x546EE0 asks whether no edit owns the keys.

name: gender lock flag clear
reason: accessor: Clears the gender lock flag 0x5C3620 at start up before the menu init (called from 0x401000); the gate 0x549A80 then runs its check.

name: gender buttons art gate
reason: Gate run at menu init: when the flag is clear it makes prototype 16075 (0x3ECB) and tests that the prototype's art exists (0x502220); when it does, the hero count becomes 13 and the new-character window gets 10 buttons (the two gender buttons); when the art is missing the flag stays 1 and gender cannot be changed. Ours always lists twelve heroes (AreaStartingHero.Premade) and never tests the art.

name: multiplayer window table set
reason: multiplayer: Sets three globals (0x5C4194 size 0x1CC, 0x5C4198 count 4, 0x5C419C table 0x5C5818) when Multiplayer.mes does not load; called only from the multiplayer interface init 0x56FF80.

name: character file list refresh
reason: Resets the selected index 0x5C3618 to -1, frees the old list (0x58A347, count 0x64C420 to 0) and reads the character files again (0x4A3D70) into list 0x64C41C; called by the load window action 0x5422C0 and 0x585270. Ours lists characters in the viewer menu with its own code.

name: game interface init
reason: startup: Intgame module init: loads mes intgame.mes into 0x64C504, makes the shared panel window (0x557230), builds seven TIG colours from art palettes, copies the five default interface words 0x5C6524 to 0x64C484, sets 0x64C534 to 2 and 0x64C674 to -1; returns 1, or 0 when the message file or window fails. Read in outline.

name: game interface reset
reason: Interface reset (death and end game resets): clears 0x64C6D8, refreshes the cursor (0x553990), resets the hotkey bar (0x57DAB0), the bar mode and filter (0x5526F0, 0x552130), clears the ten hotkey slots (0x57F210), restores the five default words and 0x64C534 and calls 0x54AA30. InterfaceModeStack.Reset covers only the stack part of the last call.

name: game interface resize layout
reason: renderer: Window resize call of Intgame: resets the hotkey UI, drops the hidden-interface window, and at a view height of 400 shows the strips again, else makes a 196 by 563 window (411 by 37) over the view and re-shows the open bar buttons. Layout only; Godot lays the HUD out itself.

name: game interface shutdown
reason: startup: Intgame shutdown: frees seven TIG colours, the shared panel window (0x5572B0) and the intgame message file; no rule.

name: game interface state save
reason: Writes the Intgame state of data2.sav: the interface mode (0x64C6A8), a bar index (0x64C530), the hotkey records (0x57DB40), five button art words (0x64C484) and a two-button state (0x64C534). Ours saves only the hotkey bar and found schematics in its own schema, so no method carries it.

name: game interface state load
reason: Reads back what 0x54A1A0 wrote: the mode is thrown away, the bar index applied (a spell target mode toggles a bar button first), the hotkey records read (0x57DBA0), then all bar buttons, the gauges (0x54B3C0), the weapon spell button (0x556EF0) and the hero's fatigue gauge are refreshed. Ours restores the hotkey bar in its own save code only.

name: game interface window init
reason: Intgame window init (1648 bytes, read in outline): copies the screen rectangles, makes the bar window (event handler 0x54C8E0), creates all bar buttons and scroll areas, the gauges and the hotkey and spell buttons, and at 0x54A68C resets the mode stack and its depth. Ours has no counterpart of the window build (buttons, gauges and scroll areas live in the viewer); only the mode stack reset at its end is Arcanum.World.InterfaceModeStack.Reset, which carries 0x54AA30.

name: game interface window free
reason: startup: Frees the bar buttons and windows made by 0x54A330 (0x51CD30, 0x58A347 on the records, one TIG colour) when the bar exists, then destroys the window 0x64C474; shutdown only.

name: interface mode stack reset
reason: Resets the mode stack: depth 0x64C6B8, the bottom slot 0x64C634 and the message log count, newest and shown words (0x64C6C0, 0x64C6C4, 0x64C6C8) to 0. Ours clears the mode stack only; the message log words are not part of InterfaceModeStack.Reset.

name: bar button create
reason: other: Creates one interface bar button from a screen rectangle minus the window origin and an art number (0x504330, 0x537B50) with press sound 3000 and release sound 3001; returns true on success. Widget creation glue; the viewer builds its own buttons.

name: bar button create from record
reason: other: Looks a record up in the button table (0x551740) and creates its button through 0x54AA60 with the record's origin; returns 0 when the record is unknown.

name: bar button create with art
reason: other: Like 0x54AAE0 but takes the art number as an extra argument; the census block also holds a frame-size button creator at 0x54AB70.

name: bar scroll area create
reason: other: Creates the two invisible scroll-area buttons (no art, no sound) of a record at its rectangle through 0x537B50; widget glue.

name: bar button destroy and hide toggle
reason: Destroys the button of a record (0x537CE0) and sets it to -1; the census block also holds the hidden-interface flag getter (0x54AC90) and the bar hide toggle (0x54ACB0, no reference anywhere in the executable per ARC-RES-123, so it is not what F10 runs; F10 runs 0x5578E0), which flips flag 0x64C6B0 and redraws the two strips. InterfaceModes.RestoresHiddenBar covers only the per-mode note; no method carries the toggle.

name: interface bar hidden flag toggle
reason: Original: with an interface bar, flips the hidden flag 0x64C6B0 between 0 and 1, redraws the two gauge strips, refreshes the game view and the bar background and returns the view refresh result; without a bar returns 0. Ours: no method carries the toggle; F10 is not its trigger (the main loop key handler runs 0x5578E0 for F10); no caller known in the export. ARC-RES-123: a byte search of the whole executable found no reference to it, so it is dead code (no rule task).

name: interface gauge number
reason: only the text of the health, fatigue and poison slots (C's %03d); the other slots' dash and question-mark fills, the font and the drawing are the viewer's

name: life gauge redraw by index
reason: renderer: Redraws gauge 0 or 1 by passing the record 0x5C63D8 or 0x5C63E8 to the PC gauge draw 0x54AF10; other values do nothing.

name: pc gauges
reason: only the filled heights (the percent truncated, 50 at a zero maximum, of the gauge height) and where the vial art goes (LifeBarRules.GaugeArt, ledger PA2-PA3 in the panel art section); a fill beyond the gauge, which the original draws from a lower art row or, below 0, with the empty art past the gauge's 88 rows, is clamped to the gauge in both modes (a technical drawing overflow); the drawing and the printed values' slots are the viewer's

name: both gauges redraw
reason: renderer: Calls the gauge redraw 0x54AEE0 for gauge 0 and gauge 1; called from the menu close and game start 0x5412E0.

name: bar counter gauge update
reason: Updates the bar's count gauges: for the hero's wielded weapon the ammunition count (art by ammo type) or, for a charged weapon with no ammo type, its charges, else the hero's gold (0x54AD00 slot 3), draws the icon (0x54B500) and in bar mode 8 with an item shows its charges gauge (slot 4: value, -1 unlimited, -2 unidentified). Ours has only the health, fatigue and poison text (LifeBars.GaugeText).

name: bar counter icon draw
reason: renderer: Looks up the gauge art of record 0x5C6470 and blits it into its button's rectangle (0x5031C0, 0x51DA80); aborts the program when the record is missing.

name: in-game event handler
reason: only the quantity window's presses (bar mode 9, ARC-UI-029): All, the arrows, the keypad digits and Backspace or Delete; Accept, Cancel, Enter and the rest of the handler (the bars' buttons, the game keys, the turn-based key filter) are the hosts'

name: bar window event handler twin
reason: Twin of the in-game event handler 0x54B5D0, installed as the bar window's handler at 0x54A3E7: key, mouse, hotkey drag and drop, bar button presses, mode keys, the right press that pops windows (table 0x54DA40). Ours has the pop rule only; read in outline.

name: spells and skills pane toggle
reason: Switches the bottom bar between its message pane and the spells (1) or skills (2) pane: hides one button group, shows the other, redraws (0x551F20, 0x551F40) and sets the bar mode (0x5506C0); the M and K keys and the buttons call it. The viewer does its own pane switching; no Arcanum.* method carries it.

name: bar button leave handler
reason: Pointer-leave filter of the bar: restores the saved hover (0x54ECD0), and when the left button is one of the bar buttons clears the hover message (0x64C674) and the message pane (0x550720); in modes 0, 1, 2 and 8 also redraws the pane (0x550930). The viewer's AreaGameBar clears hovers on its own.

name: game view mouse input
reason: only the right release's combat-mode and concealment decision; the PC's facts, the turn-based subturn gate, the interrupt and the turn toward the pointer that follow, and every other input of the handler are the host's or not implemented (its spell-targeting branch is SpellUiRules', its hotkey keys HotkeyRules'; later slices extend this row)

name: pending action click dispatcher
reason: Dispatcher for a click on an object while an action is armed: unless a round runs with another participant's turn it reads the interface mode (0x551A00): mode 1 casts the spell (0x57C110), mode 2 uses the skill (0x57A1F0), mode 16 applies the item (0x571CB0) after the picker test (0x4F2680), otherwise it runs the object click decision 0x54ED30. Only viewer scene code (follower portraits, companion orders) uses it.

name: hotkey drag active test
reason: thunk: Jumps to 0x57DE00 (whether a hotkey bar drag is going on); caller 0x573850.

name: home key centre on hero
reason: Home key in the game view: centres the view on the hero's location (0x4B8CE0) and redraws (0x558110); when the hero's tile test (0x4B8940) gives no hit and a round runs it centres on the participant whose turn it is (0x4B6D80); does nothing without a hero. InterfaceModes.FollowerOrderKeys gates the key only; no method centres the view.

name: combat mode toggle key
reason: The interface toggle of the hero's combat mode: nothing for a dead PC; in combat mode it leaves through the exit gate (0x4B3D90) or, refused, posts intgame message 24; out of combat mode it enters (0x4B3F50); afterwards it refreshes and re-sets the hovered object (0x43C270, 0x57CCF0). Ours has the toggle and its refusals but not the hover refresh.

name: hover restore after bar leave
reason: If a hovered object was saved (0x64C690) and no object is hovered now (0x43C570), sets it hovered again (0x43C270), clears the saved one and fires the hover change for it (0x57CCF0). Hover glue of the bar; no method of ours.

name: hero object click action decision
reason: The action decision of the game view's left click on an object (4032 bytes, read in outline): refusals for a hero that cannot act, itself, stoned or stunned, then the combat-mode and out-of-combat type tables pick the goal (attack, use, pick up, loot, talk, walk to a trap), with Alt, Shift and armed item (throw, drag) variants. HeroClickRules.Decide carries the tables; the armed item throw, the Alt drag and the starts are not all in it.

name: hotkey activation
reason: the item branch's plan (use, wear, hold) and the item-and-spell branch's plan; the PC test is HotkeyRules.PcCanActivate; the use, the wear (0x550000), the held cursor and the skill bar's targeting are the host's (the viewer: magical items, wear and prowling only)

name: hotkey item wear swap
reason: Hotkey wear of an item into a slot: reads the item worn there, runs the wear check, takes the old item off first, wears the new one, puts the old one back if the wear is refused, and plays the item sound. Ours: HotkeyRules.PlanItem chooses only the slot; the swap and refusal order live in the viewer.

name: college spell buttons
reason: answers the spells whose buttons show (rank by rank while known); showing the buttons is the host's

name: bottom bar mode open
reason: only bar mode 9 (the quantity window, ARC-UI-029): the count starts at 0 with the stack's units as the maximum; its buttons, icon and counter are drawn by the host; bar mode 1 (the spells, ARC-UI-053) is drawn by the viewer with SpellPaneRules; the other bar modes are not implemented

name: item spell pane build
reason: which slots show and whether a press activates; the buttons, icons and the hover description are the viewer's

name: world hover
reason: the AREA viewer's hover (ARC-UI-005, ARC-UI-057) describes and highlights the object of its own screen pick; the spell pick's tile and tile-object fallbacks are not modelled

name: interface mode change
reason: The mode stack: 0 pops, another value pushes; lock, leave then enter cases, a leave of mode 1 or 2 pops again. Ours has the stack and its steps; the cases' effects (cursor refresh, held item put back, window opens) belong to the observer host.

name: pointer pick filter set
reason: Sets which objects the pointer can pick, only when the top interface mode is 0: a hero not in combat mode gives flags 4 and 0x8200; in combat mode 0x90000004 and 0x10008200, or 0x10000004 and 0x8200 while either Alt key is held. Ours: none in the allowed assemblies.

name: message log post
reason: Posts a message: types 6-12 are shown only after 3 s since the last stored one and never stored; others go to a ring of ten, with the equal-text check for types 4 and 5. Ours: the viewer's message log, outside the allowed assemblies.

name: message window entry draw
reason: Composes the text of each message type 0-13: level-up lines, skill and spell hints (cost line '%s: %d (%d / %s)' with fatigue and maintenance), college, discipline, degree and schematic texts. Ours: the viewer's AreaHoverDescriptions and message entries, not an allowed assembly.

name: maintain slot enable or disable
reason: Enables or disables one maintained-spell slot button on the top strip and in its 32 by 32 copy. A slot already plugged stays; an empty one is disabled and drawn plugged; a slot showing an icon is clicked through the maintain bar click, so a drop of the open count (intelligence / 4) ends the spell of every slot it closes. Nearest: MaintainBarRules.Click, but nothing calls it when the open count falls.

name: cursor art refresh
reason: Does nothing while an item is held for a drag. Otherwise picks the cursor art from the interface mode on top of the mode stack: targeting mode the spell cursor, skill mode the skill cursor, game mode none, any other mode the gauntlet; then refreshes the held-item cursor. Only the viewer (not an allowed assembly) chooses cursors; none in src.

name: world hover pick
reason: Each mouse move over the play view: asks if the pointer is over the view, picks the object under the pointer (0x4F2CB0), and when it differs from the hovered object makes it the hovered object and prints its description (0x57CCF0); with nothing under the pointer it keeps a sticky attack target, else clears the hover and the message window. Only the viewer's hover window does this; none in src.

name: hovered object description
reason: the AREA viewer dispatches by type in the message mode and writes the name in a pane mode (AreaHoverWindow.Kind, ARC-UI-057, OH5); the item's examine script is not run (HK22)

name: hovered object image
reason: the AREA viewer chooses the image of a portal, container or scenery (AreaHoverWindow.Image), a critter by its flags or race (AreaLootArtLayout.HolderImage, ARC-UI-052) and a follower's portrait (ARC-UI-024); the PC's portrait is not built (IW27, OH6)

name: hovered object panel
reason: only the critter bars' text (current/maximum for the PC and its followers, else the unclamped percent); a zero maximum reads 0 % where the original divides by zero (a technical fix in both modes); the AREA viewer draws the name, the image and the bars in the message window (ARC-UI-057, OH7) and, since ARC-UI-109 (OH11), the second line (level, reaction, sneak state, alignment, the dead line) and the alignment image; the combat panel is the 0x554830 row (ARC-UI-124)

name: hovered object bar
reason: only the filled width (percent clamped to 0-100, none at 0, the share plus one pixel unless full); the art and drawing are the viewer's

name: combat panel
reason: only the hit chance and the flag bits of its term icons (the effectiveness less the difficulty of the shared check, the cancel chance share, 0 for an impossible shot); the layout and the drawing are the viewer's (AreaCombatPanelLayout, ARC-UI-124), whose art placement and hidden-interface offsets are not read

name: item type icon
reason: an index outside the tables read (before the weapon table, or past the message window's icons: an ammunition type past 33, a written subtype past 13) gives no icon where the original reads on

name: item window
reason: the AREA viewer draws the type icon and the name (HK22) and, since ARC-UI-108 (OH12–OH17, `AreaItemWindowLines`), the weapon speed, the second line, the magick or tech line, the charges or uses or ammunition per shot, the weight and the hit points; the turn-based action-point preview 0x557370 is not run (the examine script is ARC-DEV-326's), and the observer is always the local PC

name: item window text segment
reason: built in the viewer by ARC-UI-108 (OH14, `AreaItemWindowLines.Segment`)

name: item window weapon line
reason: built in the viewer by ARC-UI-108 (OH14, `AreaItemWindowLines`): damage, fatigue, to hit, range, poison, fire and electrical; the bonuses of an identified magickal item

name: item window armour line
reason: built in the viewer by ARC-UI-108 (OH15, `AreaItemWindowLines`): armour class, resistances, noise penalty and the gauntlets' unarmed bonus

name: scenery window
reason: the AREA viewer draws the image and the name in the scenery block (ARC-UI-057, OH6); the hit points line (right, red, only without object flag 0x400000) since ARC-UI-107, OH10; the flag 0x8 call is WM127

name: portal window
reason: the AREA viewer draws the image and the name (ARC-UI-057, OH6) and, since ARC-UI-107 (OH10), the lock state line (left) and the hit points (right, always), both red

name: container window
reason: the AREA viewer draws the image and the name (ARC-UI-057, OH6) and, since ARC-UI-107 (OH10), the lock state line (left) and the hit points (right, only without object flag 0x400000), both red

name: weapon stat lines
reason: Writes a weapon's lines in the inventory window: displayed damage rating, the weapon skill's effectiveness as a percent (basic or tech skill), and five damage-type ranges as min-max or 0 (0x465F70), for the item in the hero's wielded slot 1004. The viewer builds other lines (AreaItemWindowLines); no counterpart in the allowed assemblies.

name: armour stat lines
reason: Writes the armour lines of the inventory window: displayed armour rating, armour class (0x43D880) and five resistance percents (0x43D6D0) or 0. No counterpart in the allowed assemblies; nearest the viewer's item window lines.

name: weapon spell button press
reason: A press of the bar's weapon button: stores the hero's wielded weapon (slot 1004), or the given item, as the pane's item and requests bar mode 8; a second press returns the bar to mode 0. Cited in ItemSpellPaneRules' class summary only; the viewer does the press.

name: weapon spell button show
reason: the condition only; the viewer re-reads it each frame where the original refreshes the button on an inventory insert and hides it when the weapon leaves slot 1004 (0x556F80)

name: hotkey inventory callback
reason: After an item leaves or enters the hero's inventory, hotkey entries whose item moved are cleared and item entries' counts refreshed. Left out: closing bar mode 8 when its item is removed, clearing the two quick slots naming the item, hiding the weapon button, and the cursor refresh.

name: action point cost preview
reason: In turn-based mode over a hovered object: picks which cost to show by cursor and object type (use object, attack, pick up, take from container, use an item) with tests on activity, flags, being dead and the leader; asks 0x4B79A0, 0x4B78D0, 0x4B7A20 and others. The AREA viewer does not run it (registry 0x554F10).

name: locked refusal message
reason: Prints interface message 2000 in the message window; called for a hovered type 15 or 16 object whose field 0xED is 0 (an object that cannot be used). No counterpart; the viewer shows no such line.

name: alt click refusal message
reason: Callback of the message entry hook: prints entry 3000 + n of the interface message file when it exists. Its caller is the alt-click pull object action 0x4445A0, which refuses from farther than one tile; no counterpart (HeroClickRules marks Alt not read).

name: item pane button hit test
reason: In bar mode 8 with a pane item returns the index of the item spell button under the pointer; returns 5 (no drag source) when the slot's record has item triggers, 6 when the button is hidden. No counterpart (the viewer does the drag source test).

name: spell pane button hit test
reason: In bar mode 1 returns the spell button index under the pointer on the current page only when the spell is known (0x4B1950), else 5; 6 when hidden. Drag source test of the spell pane; no counterpart in src.

name: random encounter table load
reason: Module load of the random encounter tables from Rules\WMap_Rnd.mes: three tables (lines 10000+, 20000+, 30000+) and a row set; each row has MinLevel (0..32000, default 0), MaxLevel (0..32000, default 32000), GlobalFlag (0..3200, default -1), TriggerCount (default -1) and a prototype; any bad line disables random encounters. Nothing of this exists in src.
